- `form?: string`: The id of the form it belongs to, when it is not inside it.
- `(valueChanged): { value: CalendarValueOf<Mode>; details: ChangeDetails }`: Heard as a day is about to be chosen: `details.cancel()` keeps the value as it was.
- `(monthChanged): { month: string; details: ChangeDetails }`: Another month is about to be shown: its first day, and `details.cancel()`.

Each part, and its own props:

- `[kuiCalendar]` is `KuiCalendar`. `exportAs: "kuiCalendar"`. Generic: `<Mode extends CalendarMode = CalendarMode>`. Its props are above.
- `[kuiCalendarHeading]` is `KuiCalendarHeading`. Names the month shown: it writes the name before whatever is inside it.
- `[kuiCalendarPrevious]` is `KuiCalendarPrevious`.
- `[kuiCalendarNext]` is `KuiCalendarNext`.
- `[kuiCalendarMonths]` is `KuiCalendarMonths`. Structural: written `*kuiCalendarMonths`. Its template is given the entry: `let entry` is a `CalendarMonth`. `<div *kuiCalendarMonths="let month">`: once for each month shown, side by side. The parts inside each are that month's. Left out for one month.
- `[kuiCalendarGrid]` is `KuiCalendarGrid`. The table of a month's days: a grid the arrows move in, from one month shown into the next.
- `[kuiCalendarWeekdays]` is `KuiCalendarWeekdays`. Structural: written `*kuiCalendarWeekdays`. Its template is given the entry: `let entry` is a `CalendarWeekday`. `<th *kuiCalendarWeekdays="let weekday">`: once for each day of the week.
- `[kuiCalendarHeadCell]` is `KuiCalendarHeadCell`. A column's heading: a day of the week.
    - `weekday: CalendarWeekday`: Required. The day of the week it heads: an entry `Calendar.Weekdays` gave.
- `[kuiCalendarWeeks]` is `KuiCalendarWeeks`. Structural: written `*kuiCalendarWeeks`. Its template is given the entry: `let entry` is a `readonly CalendarDay[]`. `<tr *kuiCalendarWeeks="let week">`: once for each week of the month shown.
- `[kuiCalendarCell]` is `KuiCalendarCell`.
    - `date: string`: Required. The day it holds, as `Calendar.Weeks` gave it: `day.date`.
- `[kuiCalendarDay]` is `KuiCalendarDay`.
    - `date: string`: Required. The day it is the button of, as `Calendar.Weeks` gave it: `day.date`.
- `input[kuiCalendarInput]` is `KuiCalendarInput`. `<input kuiCalendarInput>`: the hidden input the value is submitted by, with a `name`.

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- root: The calendar.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-readonly`: Present when its value cannot be changed.
- previous: Shows the month before.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- next: Shows the month after.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- cell: A day's cell.
    - `data-selected`: Present on a chosen day, on every day of a chosen range, and on each day of a list. Never on a copy: a day of the month before or after shown in its own month too.
    - `data-today`: Present on today.
    - `data-outside-month`: Present on the days of the month before and after that fill the first and last weeks.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-unavailable`: Present on a day that cannot be chosen.
    - `data-range-start`: Present on the first day of a range.
    - `data-range-end`: Present on the last day of a range.
- day: The button for a day.
    - `data-selected`: Present on a chosen day, on every day of a chosen range, and on each day of a list. Never on a copy: a day of the month before or after shown in its own month too.
    - `data-today`: Present on today.
    - `data-outside-month`: Present on the days of the month before and after that fill the first and last weeks.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-unavailable`: Present on a day that cannot be chosen.
    - `data-range-start`: Present on the first day of a range.
    - `data-range-end`: Present on the last day of a range.

### Carousel

```
import { KuiCarousel, KuiCarouselViewport, KuiCarouselItem, KuiCarouselPrevious, KuiCarouselNext, KuiCarouselIndicator } from "@kirana-ui/angular"
```

Parts: `[kuiCarousel]`, `[kuiCarouselViewport]`, `[kuiCarouselItem]`, `[kuiCarouselPrevious]`, `[kuiCarouselNext]`, `[kuiCarouselIndicator]`.

Anatomy:

```
kuiCarousel
  kuiCarouselViewport
    kuiCarouselItem (repeated)
  kuiCarouselPrevious
  kuiCarouselNext
  kuiCarouselIndicator (repeated)
```

Props of its root:

- `[(index)]: number`: Which slide is at the start of the view: `[(index)]`.
- `defaultIndex?: number`: The slide it starts at, when the caller does not hold `index`. Read once. Default `0`.
- `orientation?: Orientation`: Whether the slides go across (the default) or down.
- `loop?: boolean`: Whether going on from the last slide comes round to the first.
- `(indexChanged): { index: number; details: ChangeDetails }`: Heard as another slide is about to be at the start of the view: `details.cancel()` keeps the index as it was.

Each part, and its own props:

- `[kuiCarousel]` is `KuiCarousel`. `exportAs: "kuiCarousel"`. Its props are above.
- `[kuiCarouselViewport]` is `KuiCarouselViewport`.
- `[kuiCarouselItem]` is `KuiCarouselItem`.
    - `index: number`: Required. Its place among the slides, from 0.
- `[kuiCarouselPrevious]` is `KuiCarouselPrevious`.
- `[kuiCarouselNext]` is `KuiCarouselNext`.
- `[kuiCarouselIndicator]` is `KuiCarouselIndicator`.
    - `index: number`: Required. The slide it goes to, from 0.

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- root: The carousel: a region, named by the caller.
    - `data-orientation="horizontal | vertical"`: Whether the slides go across or down.
- viewport: What scrolls. The slides are its children; the design snaps them (`scroll-snap-type`) and says whether a step glides (`scroll-behavior`).
    - `data-orientation="horizontal | vertical"`: Whether the slides go across or down.
- item: One slide.
    - `data-orientation="horizontal | vertical"`: Whether the slides go across or down.
    - `data-current`: Present on the slide the view is at, and on its button.
- previous: Goes back a slide.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- next: Goes on a slide.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- indicator: A button for one slide.
    - `data-current`: Present on the slide the view is at, and on its button.

### Checkbox

```
import { KuiCheckbox, KuiCheckboxIndicator } from "@kirana-ui/angular"
```

Parts: `[kuiCheckbox]`, `[kuiCheckboxIndicator]`.

Anatomy:

```
kuiCheckbox
  *kuiCheckboxIndicator
```

Props of its root:

- `[(checked)]: boolean`: Whether it is checked, when the caller holds it.
- `defaultChecked?: boolean`: Read once.
- `indeterminate?: boolean`: Neither checked nor unchecked: a parent of boxes that disagree.
- `parent?: boolean`: In a `kuiCheckboxGroup` with `allValues`: the box that stands for them all.
- `disabled?: boolean`: Disabled: it cannot be changed.
- `readOnly?: boolean`: Shown as it is, focusable, not changeable.
- `required?: boolean`: Needed: in a `Field`, leaving it unchecked is then invalid.
- `name?: string`: With a name, the control is submitted with the form around it when it is checked.
- `form?: string`: The id of the form the control belongs to, when it is not inside it.
- `value?: string`: What is submitted. Default `"on"`, as a native checkbox's.
- `(checkedChanged): { checked: boolean; details: ChangeDetails }`: The change with why it happened; `details.cancel()` keeps the value.

Each part, and its own props:

- `[kuiCheckbox]` is `KuiCheckbox`. `exportAs: "kuiCheckbox"`. On the box's element. It draws the hidden native input inside it, which a form and a label reach. Its props are above.
- `[kuiCheckboxIndicator]` is `KuiCheckboxIndicator`. Structural: written `*kuiCheckboxIndicator`. `<span *kuiCheckboxIndicator>`: in the page while the box is checked or indeterminate.

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- root: The box. It holds a hidden native checkbox, which a form and a label reach.
    - `data-checked`: Present when it is checked.
    - `data-unchecked`: Present when it is not checked.
    - `data-indeterminate`: Present when it is neither checked nor unchecked.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-readonly`: Present when it can be read but not changed.
    - `data-required`: Present when the form needs it.
    - `data-parent`: Present on the checkbox that stands for every box of its group.
- indicator: The mark. In the page while the box is checked or indeterminate.
    - `data-checked`: Present when it is checked.
    - `data-unchecked`: Present when it is not checked.
    - `data-indeterminate`: Present when it is neither checked nor unchecked.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-readonly`: Present when it can be read but not changed.
    - `data-required`: Present when the form needs it.
    - `data-starting-style`: Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from.
    - `data-ending-style`: Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends.

### CheckboxGroup

```
import { KuiCheckboxGroup } from "@kirana-ui/angular"
```

Props:

- `[(value)]: readonly string[]`: The values of the checked checkboxes, when the caller holds them.
- `defaultValue?: readonly string[]`: The values checked at the start, when the caller does not hold `value`. Read once.
- `allValues?: readonly string[]`: The value of every checkbox of the group, for a parent checkbox.
- `disabled?: boolean`: Disables every checkbox of the group.
- `(valueChanged): { value: string[]; details: ChangeDetails }`: The change with why it happened; `details.cancel()` keeps the value.

`[kuiCheckboxGroup]` is `KuiCheckboxGroup`. `exportAs: "kuiCheckboxGroup"`. Checkboxes that hold one list of values. Each `kuiCheckbox` with a `value` inside it is checked while the list has its value; with `allValues`, a `kuiCheckbox` marked `parent` stands for them all.

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- root: The group. A checkbox inside it with a `value` is checked while the group's value holds it; one marked `parent` stands for every value of `allValues`.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.

### Collapsible

```
import { KuiCollapsible, KuiCollapsibleTrigger, KuiCollapsiblePanel } from "@kirana-ui/angular"
```

Parts: `[kuiCollapsible]`, `[kuiCollapsibleTrigger]`, `[kuiCollapsiblePanel]`.

Anatomy:

```
kuiCollapsible
  kuiCollapsibleTrigger (repeated)
  *kuiCollapsiblePanel
```

Props of its root:

- `[(open)]: boolean`: Whether it is open, when the caller holds it.
- `defaultOpen?: boolean`: Read once.
- `disabled?: boolean`: Disabled: its trigger does not open or close it.
- `(openChanged): { open: boolean; details: ChangeDetails }`: The change with why it happened; `details.cancel()` keeps the value.

Each part, and its own props:

- `[kuiCollapsible]` is `KuiCollapsible`. `exportAs: "kuiCollapsible"`. Its props are above.
- `[kuiCollapsibleTrigger]` is `KuiCollapsibleTrigger`.
- `[kuiCollapsiblePanel]` is `KuiCollapsiblePanel`. Structural: written `*kuiCollapsiblePanel`. `<div *kuiCollapsiblePanel>`: in the page while open; `{ keepMounted: true }` keeps it, hidden.
    - `*kuiCollapsiblePanel: { keepMounted?: boolean } | ""`: The directive's own value: `*kuiCollapsiblePanel="…"`. Its options: `{ keepMounted: true }` keeps the panel in the page, hidden, while it is closed.

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- root: Groups the trigger and the panel.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- trigger: The button that opens and closes the panel.
    - `data-panel-open`: Present when the panel is open.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- panel: The content. In the page while open, and through its exit's motion.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-starting-style`: Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from.
    - `data-ending-style`: Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends.
    - `--collapsible-panel-height`: The panel's content height while it opens or closes, `auto` once it is open.
    - `--collapsible-panel-width`: The panel's content width while it opens or closes, `auto` once it is open.

### Combobox

```
import { KuiCombobox, KuiComboboxInput, KuiComboboxTrigger, KuiComboboxValue, KuiComboboxClear, KuiComboboxChips, KuiComboboxChip, KuiComboboxChipRemove, KuiComboboxPortal, KuiComboboxPositioner, KuiComboboxPopup, KuiComboboxList, KuiComboboxCollection, KuiComboboxGroup, KuiComboboxGroupLabel, KuiComboboxSeparator, KuiComboboxItem, KuiComboboxItemIndicator, KuiComboboxEmpty, KuiComboboxStatus, KuiComboboxHiddenInput } from "@kirana-ui/angular"
```

Parts: `[kuiCombobox]`, `input[kuiComboboxInput]`, `[kuiComboboxTrigger]`, `[kuiComboboxValue]`, `[kuiComboboxClear]`, `[kuiComboboxChips]`, `[kuiComboboxChip]`, `[kuiComboboxChipRemove]`, `[kuiComboboxPortal]`, `[kuiComboboxPositioner]`, `[kuiComboboxPopup]`, `[kuiComboboxList]`, `[kuiComboboxCollection]`, `[kuiComboboxGroup]`, `[kuiComboboxGroupLabel]`, `[kuiComboboxSeparator]`, `[kuiComboboxItem]`, `[kuiComboboxItemIndicator]`, `[kuiComboboxEmpty]`, `[kuiComboboxStatus]`.

Anatomy:

```
kuiCombobox
  input[kuiComboboxInput]
  kuiComboboxTrigger
    *kuiComboboxValue (optional)
  *kuiComboboxPortal
    kuiComboboxPositioner
      kuiComboboxPopup
        input[kuiComboboxInput] (as above)
        kuiComboboxList (optional)
          *kuiComboboxCollection (optional)
            kuiComboboxItem (repeated, as above)
            kuiComboboxGroup (optional, repeated, as above)
          kuiComboboxGroup (optional, repeated)
            *kuiComboboxCollection (optional, as above)
            kuiComboboxItem (repeated)
              *kuiComboboxItemIndicator
            kuiComboboxGroupLabel
          kuiComboboxSeparator (repeated)
        *kuiComboboxCollection (optional, as above)
        *kuiComboboxEmpty
        kuiComboboxStatus (optional)
  kuiComboboxPopup (as above)
  kuiComboboxStatus (optional, as above)
  *kuiComboboxClear
  kuiComboboxChips
    input[kuiComboboxInput] (as above)
    kuiComboboxChip (repeated)
      kuiComboboxChipRemove
  input[kuiComboboxHiddenInput] (Angular only)
```

Props of its root:

- `[(value)]: Value | null`: The chosen value; `null` is "none".
- `defaultValue?: NoInfer<Value> | null`: The value it starts with, when the caller does not hold `value`. Read once.
- `[(inputValue)]: string`: What the input says, `[(inputValue)]`. With `kuiAutocomplete` the text is `[(value)]`.
- `defaultInputValue?: string`: The text the input starts with, when the caller does not hold `inputValue`. Read once.
- `[(open)]: boolean`: Whether the list is open, when the caller holds it.
- `defaultOpen?: boolean`: Whether the list starts open, when the caller does not hold `open`. Read once.
- `disabled?: boolean`: Disabled: it cannot be changed.
- `readOnly?: boolean`: Its value can be read and not changed: the list still opens and can be gone through, but no press and no Enter chooses, nothing typed is taken, and its clear and chip buttons do nothing. Its value is still submitted.
- `name?: string`: With a name, the value is submitted with the form around it.
- `form?: string`: The id of the form the control belongs to, when it is not inside it.
- `items?: readonly ComboboxItemData<Value>[] | readonly ComboboxGroupData<Value>[] | Readonly<Record<string, string>>`: The values with their labels: a list of them, groups of them (`{ value, items }`), or the labels by value. With a `*kuiComboboxCollection` it is the list itself: the combobox filters it, and the collection draws what is left.
- `filter?: ((label: string, query: string) => boolean) | null`: Whether an item is shown for what was typed; `null` shows every item.
- `required?: boolean`: In a field, "none" is then wrong.
- `multiple?: boolean`: Several values, each shown as a chip: they are `values`, not `value`.
- `[(values)]: readonly Value[]`: With `multiple`: the chosen values, in the order they were chosen, `[(values)]`.
- `defaultValues?: readonly Value[]`: With `multiple`: the values it starts with, when the caller does not hold `values`. Read once.
- `(valuesChanged): { values: Value[]; details: ChangeDetails }`: With `multiple`: heard as a value is about to be added or taken away; `details.cancel()` keeps the values as they were.
- `inline?: boolean`: The list is always in the page, with no popup: a command palette.
- `virtualized?: ListCollection`: Every row, when only some are in the page: each item is then given its `index`.
- `autoHighlight?: boolean`: The first item shown for what was typed is highlighted as one types, so Enter chooses it. Off by default.
- `mode?: "list" | "none"`: With `kuiAutocomplete`: `"none"` shows the suggestions as the caller draws them.
- `openOnInputClick?: boolean`: With `kuiAutocomplete`: a press on the input opens the list.
- `(valueChanged): { value: Value | null; details: ChangeDetails }`: Heard as a value is about to be chosen or cleared: `details.cancel()` keeps it as it was.
- `(inputValueChanged): { value: string; details: ChangeDetails }`: Heard as the input's text is about to change; `details.cancel()` keeps it as it was.
- `(openChanged): { open: boolean; details: ChangeDetails }`: Heard as the list is about to open or close: `details.cancel()` keeps it as it was.

Each part, and its own props:

- `[kuiCombobox]` is `KuiCombobox`. `exportAs: "kuiCombobox"`. Generic: `<Value = unknown>`. `kuiAutocomplete` is a combobox whose text is the value: `[(value)]` is the text, and the list only suggests. Its parts are the combobox's directives. Its props are above.
- `input[kuiComboboxInput]` is `KuiComboboxInput`. `<input kuiComboboxInput>`: what is typed filters the list, which is placed against it.
- `[kuiComboboxTrigger]` is `KuiComboboxTrigger`.
- `[kuiComboboxValue]` is `KuiComboboxValue`. Structural: written `*kuiComboboxValue`. Its template is given the entry: `let entry` is a `ComboboxShown`. `<span kuiComboboxValue [placeholder]="'Pick one'">` says the chosen value's label, or its placeholder while nothing is chosen; with `multiple`, the chosen labels with commas between. `<ng-container *kuiComboboxValue="let shown">` draws its own content instead, with what is chosen: `shown.value` and `shown.label`, with `multiple` `shown.values` and `shown.labels`, in the order they were chosen. For a button that is the combobox, its input inside the popup.
    - `placeholder?: string`: Shown while nothing is chosen.
- `[kuiComboboxClear]` is `KuiComboboxClear`. Structural: written `*kuiComboboxClear`. `<button *kuiComboboxClear>`: empties the input and the value; in the page while there is something to clear.
- `[kuiComboboxChips]` is `KuiComboboxChips`. With `multiple`: what holds the chips and the input.
- `[kuiComboboxChip]` is `KuiComboboxChip`. With `multiple`: one chosen value. Its `value` is what its remove button takes away.
    - `value: unknown`: Required. The chosen value this chip stands for.
- `[kuiComboboxChipRemove]` is `KuiComboboxChipRemove`.
- `[kuiComboboxPortal]` is `KuiComboboxPortal`. Structural: written `*kuiComboboxPortal`. Draws what it holds at the end of `<body>`, or in the container a `PortalProvider` names.
- `[kuiComboboxPositioner]` is `KuiComboboxPositioner`. Takes the positioner options ("Positioner options", above).
- `[kuiComboboxPopup]` is `KuiComboboxPopup`.
- `[kuiComboboxList]` is `KuiComboboxList`. The items' own box inside the popup, when the popup holds more than items (an input): it is then the listbox.
- `[kuiComboboxCollection]` is `KuiComboboxCollection`. Structural: written `*kuiComboboxCollection`. Its template is given the entry: `let entry` is a `ComboboxEntry`. `<ng-container *kuiComboboxCollection="let entry">` draws the list from the root's `items`: once for each item left for what was typed, or for each group that has items left. With `of` (`*kuiComboboxCollection="let item; of: group"`), for each of that group's items left. The root then filters, and no item hides itself.
    - `of?: ComboboxEntry`: Written after the directive's value: `*kuiComboboxCollection="…; of: …"`. A group the root's `items` gave: its items left are then what is drawn.
- `[kuiComboboxGroup]` is `KuiComboboxGroup`. Items that belong together, named by their `kuiComboboxGroupLabel`. Hidden while none is shown.
- `[kuiComboboxGroupLabel]` is `KuiComboboxGroupLabel`. Names the group it is in. With no group around it, it is plain text.
- `[kuiComboboxSeparator]` is `KuiComboboxSeparator`. A line between groups.
- `[kuiComboboxItem]` is `KuiComboboxItem`.
    - `value: unknown`: Required. What the combobox's value is while this item is chosen.
    - `disabled?: boolean`: Disables this item: it cannot be chosen, and the arrows pass over it.
    - `label?: string`: What is filtered and what the input shows; the item's text when left out.
    - `index?: number`: Its place among all the rows, in a virtualized list.
- `[kuiComboboxItemIndicator]` is `KuiComboboxItemIndicator`. Structural: written `*kuiComboboxItemIndicator`. `<span *kuiComboboxItemIndicator>`: in the page while its item is the chosen one.
- `[kuiComboboxEmpty]` is `KuiComboboxEmpty`. Structural: written `*kuiComboboxEmpty`. `<div *kuiComboboxEmpty>`: in the page while no item is shown for what was typed.
- `[kuiComboboxStatus]` is `KuiComboboxStatus`. Says how the list stands ("3 results", "Loading") to software that reads the page, as its text changes. Keep it in the page and change what it holds: inside the popup, or beside the input.
- `input[kuiComboboxHiddenInput]` is `KuiComboboxHiddenInput`. `<input kuiComboboxHiddenInput>`: submits the value with the form around it. Angular only.

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- input: The text input. What is typed filters the list, which is placed against it, or against the chips' box when it is in one. Inside the popup, it takes focus while the popup is open.
    - `data-popup-open`: Present when the list is open.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-readonly`: Present when it can be read but not changed.
- trigger: A button that opens and closes the list. With the input inside the popup it is the combobox: a stop for Tab, and what the popup is placed against.
    - `data-popup-open`: Present when the list is open.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-readonly`: Present when it can be read but not changed.
- positioner: Places the list against the input: against the chips' box when the input is in one, the button when the input is inside the popup, or its own `anchor`. It carries the geometry.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-side="top | right | bottom | left | inline-start | inline-end"`: The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip. Asked for as `inline-start` or `inline-end`, it says one of those two when it is beside its anchor.
    - `data-align="start | center | end"`: How it is aligned with the anchor.
    - `--anchor-width`: The anchor's width.
    - `--anchor-height`: The anchor's height.
    - `--available-width`: The width between the anchor and the edge of the viewport.
    - `--available-height`: The height between the anchor and the edge of the viewport.
    - `--transform-origin`: The point of the popup nearest its anchor, to scale from.
- popup: The list of items. With a `list` inside, what holds it: a dialog around an input and the list.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-starting-style`: Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from.
    - `data-ending-style`: Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends.
    - `data-side="top | right | bottom | left | inline-start | inline-end"`: The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip. Asked for as `inline-start` or `inline-end`, it says one of those two when it is beside its anchor.
    - `data-align="start | center | end"`: How it is aligned with the anchor.
    - `data-empty`: Present when no item is shown for what was typed.
- list: The items' own box inside the popup, when the popup holds more than items (an input): it is then the listbox.
    - `data-empty`: Present when no item is shown for what was typed.
- item: One choice in the list.
    - `data-selected`: Present on the chosen item.
    - `data-highlighted`: Present on the item the pointer or the keyboard is on.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- clear: A button that empties the input and the value.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- chipRemove: A chip's button that takes its value away.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.

### Command

```
import { KuiCommand, KuiCommandInput, KuiCommandList, KuiCommandEmpty, KuiCommandGroup, KuiCommandGroupHeading, KuiCommandItem, KuiCommandSeparator } from "@kirana-ui/angular"
```

Parts: `[kuiCommand]`, `[kuiCommandInput]`, `[kuiCommandList]`, `[kuiCommandEmpty]`, `[kuiCommandGroup]`, `[kuiCommandGroupHeading]`, `[kuiCommandItem]`, `[kuiCommandSeparator]`.

Anatomy:

```
kuiCommand
  kuiCommandInput
  kuiCommandList
    *kuiCommandEmpty
    kuiCommandGroup (optional, repeated)
      kuiCommandGroupHeading
      kuiCommandItem (repeated)
    kuiCommandSeparator (repeated)
```

Props of its root:

- `[(inputValue)]: string`: What the input says.
- `defaultInputValue?: string`: The text the input starts with, when the caller does not hold `inputValue`. Read once. Default `""`.
- `filter?: ((label: string, query: string, keywords: readonly string[]) => boolean) | null`: Whether an item is shown for what was typed; `null` shows every item.
- `loop?: boolean`: Whether a step past an end of the list goes round to the other.
- `autoHighlight?: boolean`: Whether the first item shown is highlighted from the start. Default: `true`.
- `disabled?: boolean`: Disabled: nothing can be typed or chosen.
- `(inputValueChanged): { value: string; details: ChangeDetails }`: Heard as the input's text is about to change: `details.cancel()` keeps it as it was.
- `(itemSelected): { value: string; details: ChangeDetails }`: An item was chosen.

Each part, and its own props:

- `[kuiCommand]` is `KuiCommand`. `exportAs: "kuiCommand"`. Its props are above.
- `[kuiCommandInput]` is `KuiCommandInput`.
- `[kuiCommandList]` is `KuiCommandList`.
- `[kuiCommandEmpty]` is `KuiCommandEmpty`. Structural: written `*kuiCommandEmpty`. `<div *kuiCommandEmpty>`: in the page while no item is shown for what was typed.
- `[kuiCommandGroup]` is `KuiCommandGroup`. Items under a `kuiCommandGroupHeading`. Hidden while none of them is shown.
- `[kuiCommandGroupHeading]` is `KuiCommandGroupHeading`. A group's name.
- `[kuiCommandItem]` is `KuiCommandItem`.
    - `value: string`: Required. What `itemSelected` is told.
    - `disabled?: boolean`: Disables this item: it cannot be chosen, and the arrows pass over it.
    - `label?: string`: What is filtered; the item's text when left out.
    - `keywords?: readonly string[]`: Other words the item answers to.
- `[kuiCommandSeparator]` is `KuiCommandSeparator`. A line between groups: gone while something is typed, unless `alwaysRender`.
    - `alwaysRender?: boolean`: Stays while something is typed.

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- root: A list of commands with the input that filters it.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- input: The text input. What is typed filters the list; focus stays in it.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- list: The commands.
    - `data-empty`: Present when no item is shown for what was typed.
- item: One command.
    - `data-highlighted`: Present on the item the pointer or the keyboard is on.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.

### ContextMenu

```
import { KuiMenu, KuiContextMenuTrigger, KuiMenuPortal, KuiMenuPositioner, KuiMenuPopup, KuiMenuArrow, KuiMenuItem, KuiMenuLinkItem, KuiMenuGroup, KuiMenuGroupLabel, KuiMenuSeparator, KuiMenuCheckboxItem, KuiMenuCheckboxItemIndicator, KuiMenuRadioGroup, KuiMenuRadioItem, KuiMenuRadioItemIndicator, KuiMenuSubmenuRoot, KuiMenuSubmenuTrigger } from "@kirana-ui/angular"
```

Parts: `[kuiContextMenu]`, `[kuiContextMenuTrigger]`, `[kuiMenuPortal]`, `[kuiMenuPositioner]`, `[kuiMenuPopup]`, `[kuiMenuArrow]`, `[kuiMenuItem]`, `a[kuiMenuLinkItem]`, `[kuiMenuGroup]`, `[kuiMenuGroupLabel]`, `[kuiMenuSeparator]`, `[kuiMenuCheckboxItem]`, `[kuiMenuCheckboxItemIndicator]`, `[kuiMenuRadioGroup]`, `[kuiMenuRadioItem]`, `[kuiMenuRadioItemIndicator]`, `[kuiMenuSubmenuRoot]`, `[kuiMenuSubmenuTrigger]`.

Anatomy:

```
kuiContextMenu
  kuiContextMenuTrigger
  *kuiMenuPortal
    kuiMenuPositioner
      kuiMenuPopup
        kuiMenuArrow
        kuiMenuGroup (optional, repeated)
          kuiMenuItem (repeated)
          a[kuiMenuLinkItem] (repeated)
          kuiMenuGroupLabel
          kuiMenuCheckboxItem (repeated)
            *kuiMenuCheckboxItemIndicator
          kuiMenuRadioGroup (repeated)
            kuiMenuRadioItem (repeated)
              *kuiMenuRadioItemIndicator
          kuiMenuSubmenuRoot (repeated)
            *kuiMenuPortal (as above)
            kuiMenuSubmenuTrigger
        kuiMenuSeparator (repeated)
```

Props of its root:

- `[(open)]: boolean`: Whether it is open, when the caller holds it.
- `defaultOpen?: boolean`: Whether it starts open, when the caller does not hold `open`. Read once.
- `disabled?: boolean`: The trigger cannot be pressed; a submenu's is passed over.
- `loop?: boolean`: Whether the arrows go round from the last item to the first. Default: they do.
- `modal?: boolean`: Holds the page while the menu is open. Not for a submenu.
- `(openChanged): { open: boolean; details: ChangeDetails }`: Heard as it is about to open or close: `details.cancel()` keeps it as it was.

Each part, and its own props:

- `[kuiContextMenu]` is `KuiMenu`. `exportAs: "kuiMenu"`. `kuiContextMenu` in place of `kuiMenu` is a menu for an area of the page, opened at the pointer: its trigger is `kuiContextMenuTrigger`, its other parts the menu's. Its props are above.
- `[kuiContextMenuTrigger]` is `KuiContextMenuTrigger`. The area a secondary press, or a long press on a touch screen, opens a `kuiContextMenu` in.
- `[kuiMenuPortal]` is `KuiMenuPortal`. Structural: written `*kuiMenuPortal`. Draws what it holds at the end of `<body>`, or in the container a `PortalProvider` names.
- `[kuiMenuPositioner]` is `KuiMenuPositioner`. Takes the positioner options ("Positioner options", above).
- `[kuiMenuPopup]` is `KuiMenuPopup`.
- `[kuiMenuArrow]` is `KuiMenuArrow`.
- `[kuiMenuItem]` is `KuiMenuItem`.
    - `disabled?: boolean`: Disables this item: it cannot be pressed, and the arrows pass over it.
    - `label?: string`: What typing matches; the item's text when left out.
    - `closeOnClick?: boolean`: Whether choosing the item closes the menu. Default: it does.
- `a[kuiMenuLinkItem]` is `KuiMenuLinkItem`. `<a kuiMenuLinkItem href="…">`: an item that is a link.
    - `disabled?: boolean`: Disables this item: it cannot be pressed, and the arrows pass over it.
    - `label?: string`: What typing matches; the item's text when left out.
    - `closeOnClick?: boolean`: Whether choosing the item closes the menu. Default: it does.
- `[kuiMenuGroup]` is `KuiMenuGroup`. Items that belong together, named by their label.
- `[kuiMenuGroupLabel]` is `KuiMenuGroupLabel`. Names the group it is in. With no group around it, it is plain text.
- `[kuiMenuSeparator]` is `KuiMenuSeparator`. A line between items.
- `[kuiMenuCheckboxItem]` is `KuiMenuCheckboxItem`. `exportAs: "kuiMenuCheckboxItem"`.
    - `[(checked)]: boolean`: Whether the item is checked, when the caller holds it.
    - `defaultChecked?: boolean`: Whether the item starts checked, when the caller does not hold `checked`. Read once.
    - `disabled?: boolean`: Disables this item: it cannot be pressed, and the arrows pass over it.
    - `label?: string`: What typing matches; the item's text when left out.
    - `closeOnClick?: boolean`: Whether choosing the item closes the menu. Default: it does not.
    - `(checkedChanged): { checked: boolean; details: ChangeDetails }`: Heard as the item is about to be checked or unchecked: `details.cancel()` keeps it as it was.
- `[kuiMenuCheckboxItemIndicator]` is `KuiMenuCheckboxItemIndicator`. Structural: written `*kuiMenuCheckboxItemIndicator`. `<span *kuiMenuCheckboxItemIndicator>`: in the page while its item is checked.
- `[kuiMenuRadioGroup]` is `KuiMenuRadioGroup`. `exportAs: "kuiMenuRadioGroup"`. Generic: `<Value = unknown>`.
    - `[(value)]: Value | null`: The chosen value; `null` is "none".
    - `defaultValue?: NoInfer<Value> | null`: The value it starts with, when the caller does not hold `value`. Read once.
    - `disabled?: boolean`: Disables every item of the group.
    - `(valueChanged): { value: Value; details: ChangeDetails }`: Told an item's own value, never `null`: a press chooses, and nothing takes the choice back.
- `[kuiMenuRadioItem]` is `KuiMenuRadioItem`.
    - `value: unknown`: Required. What the radio group's value is while this item is the chosen one.
    - `disabled?: boolean`: Disables this item: it cannot be pressed, and the arrows pass over it.
    - `label?: string`: What typing matches; the item's text when left out.
    - `closeOnClick?: boolean`: Whether choosing the item closes the menu. Default: it does not.
- `[kuiMenuRadioItemIndicator]` is `KuiMenuRadioItemIndicator`. Structural: written `*kuiMenuRadioItemIndicator`. `<span *kuiMenuRadioItemIndicator>`: in the page while its item is the chosen one.
- `[kuiMenuSubmenuRoot]` is `KuiMenuSubmenuRoot`. `exportAs: "kuiMenuSubmenuRoot"`. A menu that one of this menu's items opens. Its trigger is `kuiMenuSubmenuTrigger`.
    - `[(open)]: boolean`: Whether it is open, when the caller holds it.
    - `defaultOpen?: boolean`: Whether it starts open, when the caller does not hold `open`. Read once.
    - `disabled?: boolean`: The trigger cannot be pressed; a submenu's is passed over.
    - `loop?: boolean`: Whether the arrows go round from the last item to the first. Default: they do.
    - `modal?: boolean`: Holds the page while the menu is open. Not for a submenu.
    - `(openChanged): { open: boolean; details: ChangeDetails }`: Heard as it is about to open or close: `details.cancel()` keeps it as it was.
- `[kuiMenuSubmenuTrigger]` is `KuiMenuSubmenuTrigger`. On the item of a menu that opens the submenu around it (`kuiMenuSubmenuRoot`).

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- trigger: The area a secondary press, or a long press on a touch screen, opens the menu in.
    - `data-popup-open`: Present when the menu is open.
- positioner: Places the menu against its trigger. It carries the geometry.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-side="top | right | bottom | left | inline-start | inline-end"`: The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip. Asked for as `inline-start` or `inline-end`, it says one of those two when it is beside its anchor.
    - `data-align="start | center | end"`: How it is aligned with the anchor.
    - `--anchor-width`: The anchor's width.
    - `--anchor-height`: The anchor's height.
    - `--available-width`: The width between the anchor and the edge of the viewport.
    - `--available-height`: The height between the anchor and the edge of the viewport.
    - `--transform-origin`: The point of the popup nearest its anchor, to scale from.
- popup: The menu itself: the list of items.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-starting-style`: Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from.
    - `data-ending-style`: Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends.
    - `data-side="top | right | bottom | left | inline-start | inline-end"`: The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip. Asked for as `inline-start` or `inline-end`, it says one of those two when it is beside its anchor.
    - `data-align="start | center | end"`: How it is aligned with the anchor.
- arrow: An element that points at the trigger.
    - `data-side="top | right | bottom | left | inline-start | inline-end"`: The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip. Asked for as `inline-start` or `inline-end`, it says one of those two when it is beside its anchor.
    - `data-align="start | center | end"`: How it is aligned with the anchor.
    - `data-uncentered`: Present when the arrow cannot sit at the trigger's centre.
- item: An action. Choosing it closes the menu.
    - `data-highlighted`: Present on the item the pointer or the keyboard is on.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- linkItem: An item that is a link. Choosing it follows the link and closes the menu.
    - `data-highlighted`: Present on the item the pointer or the keyboard is on.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- checkboxItem: An item that is checked or not. Choosing it leaves the menu open.
    - `data-checked`: Present when it is checked.
    - `data-unchecked`: Present when it is not checked.
    - `data-highlighted`: Present on the item the pointer or the keyboard is on.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- checkboxItemIndicator: A mark a checkbox item shows while it is checked.
    - `data-checked`: Present when it is checked.
    - `data-unchecked`: Present when it is not checked.
- radioGroup: Radio items of which one is chosen.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- radioItem: One choice of a radio group. Choosing it leaves the menu open.
    - `data-checked`: Present when it is checked.
    - `data-unchecked`: Present when it is not checked.
    - `data-highlighted`: Present on the item the pointer or the keyboard is on.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- radioItemIndicator: A mark a radio item shows while it is the chosen one.
    - `data-checked`: Present when it is checked.
    - `data-unchecked`: Present when it is not checked.
- submenuTrigger: An item that opens a menu beside it.
    - `data-popup-open`: Present when its menu is open.
    - `data-highlighted`: Present on the item the pointer or the keyboard is on.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.

### DateField

```
import { KuiDateField, KuiDateFieldSegments, KuiDateFieldSegment, KuiDateFieldInput } from "@kirana-ui/angular"
```

Parts: `[kuiDateField]`, `[kuiDateFieldSegments]`, `[kuiDateFieldSegment]`, `input[kuiDateFieldInput]`.

Anatomy:

```
kuiDateField
  *kuiDateFieldSegments
    kuiDateFieldSegment (repeated)
  input[kuiDateFieldInput]
```

Props of its root:

- `[(value)]: string | null`: The day typed, once all of it is: `[(value)]`.
- `defaultValue?: string | null`: The value it starts with, when the caller does not hold `value`. Read once.
- `locale?: string`: The language and region that order the day, the month and the year. Default `"en-US"`.
- `min?: string`: The first and the last day it takes: outside them it says it is invalid.
- `max?: string`: The last day it takes.
- `placeholders?: Partial<Record<DateUnit, string>>`: What an empty part shows. Default: `dd`, `mm`, `yyyy`.
- `disabled?: boolean`: Disabled: it cannot be changed.
- `readOnly?: boolean`: Shown as it is, focusable, not changeable.
- `required?: boolean`: Needed: in a `Field`, leaving it empty is then invalid.
- `name?: string`: The name it is submitted under, by its hidden input.
- `form?: string`: The id of the form it belongs to, when it is not inside it.
- `(valueChanged): { value: string | null; details: ChangeDetails }`: Heard as the day is about to change, once all of it is typed or as it is cleared: `details.cancel()` keeps the value as it was.

Each part, and its own props:

- `[kuiDateField]` is `KuiDateField`. `exportAs: "kuiDateField"`. Its props are above.
- `[kuiDateFieldSegments]` is `KuiDateFieldSegments`. Structural: written `*kuiDateFieldSegments`. Its template is given the entry: `let entry` is a `DateFieldSegment`. `<span *kuiDateFieldSegments="let segment">`: once for each piece of the date.
- `[kuiDateFieldSegment]` is `KuiDateFieldSegment`. One piece: a part that is typed, or what stands between two. It writes its own text.
    - `segment: DateFieldSegment`: Required. The piece it is: an entry `DateField.Segments` gave.
- `input[kuiDateFieldInput]` is `KuiDateFieldInput`. `<input kuiDateFieldInput>`: the hidden input it is submitted by.

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- root: The field: a group of the date's parts.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-readonly`: Present when its value cannot be changed.
    - `data-invalid`: Present when the date is outside what it takes, or is asked for and half typed.
- segment: One piece of the date: a part that is typed, or what stands between two.
    - `data-segment="day | month | year | literal"`: Which piece it is.
    - `data-placeholder`: Present on a part that is empty.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-invalid`: Present when the date is outside what it takes, or is asked for and half typed.

### DatePicker

```
import { KuiDatePicker, KuiDatePickerField, KuiDateFieldSegments, KuiDateFieldSegment, KuiDateFieldInput, KuiPopoverTrigger, KuiPopoverPortal, KuiPopoverPositioner, KuiPopoverPopup, KuiDatePickerCalendar, KuiCalendarHeading, KuiCalendarPrevious, KuiCalendarNext, KuiCalendarMonths, KuiCalendarGrid, KuiCalendarWeekdays, KuiCalendarHeadCell, KuiCalendarWeeks, KuiCalendarCell, KuiCalendarDay } from "@kirana-ui/angular"
```

Parts: `[kuiDatePicker]`, `[kuiDatePickerField]`, `[kuiDateFieldSegments]`, `[kuiDateFieldSegment]`, `input[kuiDateFieldInput]`, `[kuiPopoverTrigger]`, `[kuiPopoverPortal]`, `[kuiPopoverPositioner]`, `[kuiPopoverPopup]`, `[kuiDatePickerCalendar]`, `[kuiCalendarHeading]`, `[kuiCalendarPrevious]`, `[kuiCalendarNext]`, `[kuiCalendarMonths]`, `[kuiCalendarGrid]`, `[kuiCalendarWeekdays]`, `[kuiCalendarHeadCell]`, `[kuiCalendarWeeks]`, `[kuiCalendarCell]`, `[kuiCalendarDay]`.

Anatomy:

```
kuiDatePicker
  kuiDatePickerField
    *kuiDateFieldSegments
      kuiDateFieldSegment (repeated)
    input[kuiDateFieldInput]
  kuiPopoverTrigger
  *kuiPopoverPortal
    kuiPopoverPositioner
      kuiPopoverPopup
        kuiDatePickerCalendar
          *kuiCalendarMonths (optional)
            kuiCalendarHeading
            kuiCalendarGrid
              *kuiCalendarWeekdays
                kuiCalendarHeadCell (repeated)
              *kuiCalendarWeeks
                kuiCalendarCell (repeated)
                  kuiCalendarDay
          kuiCalendarPrevious
          kuiCalendarNext
```

Props of its root:

- `[(value)]: string | null`: The day, typed or picked; `null` for none.
- `defaultValue?: string | null`: The value it starts with, when the caller does not hold `value`. Read once.
- `[(open)]: boolean`: Whether the calendar is open, when the caller holds it.
- `defaultOpen?: boolean`: Whether the calendar starts open, when the caller does not hold `open`. Read once.
- `locale?: string`: The language and region of the field and the calendar. Give it: a server does not know.
- `min?: string`: The first and the last day that can be typed or picked.
- `max?: string`: The last day that can be typed or picked.
- `isDateUnavailable?: CalendarProps["isDateUnavailable"]`: Days that cannot be picked in the calendar.
- `calendarSystem?: CalendarProps["calendarSystem"]`: The calendar its months are laid out in, when it is not the Gregorian one.
- `fixedWeeks?: boolean`: Always six rows of days.
- `months?: number`: How many months the calendar shows side by side.
- `pagedNavigation?: boolean`: With several `months`: Previous and Next turn them all rather than one month.
- `[(month)]: string`: The first day of the month the calendar shows (any day of it): `[(month)]`.
- `defaultMonth?: string`: The month the calendar starts on, when the caller does not hold `month`. Read once.
- `placeholders?: DateFieldProps["placeholders"]`: What an empty part of the field shows.
- `disabled?: boolean`: Disabled: it cannot be changed.
- `readOnly?: boolean`: Shown as it is, focusable, not changeable.
- `required?: boolean`: Needed: in a `Field`, leaving it empty is then invalid.
- `name?: string`: The name it is submitted under.
- `form?: string`: The id of the form it belongs to, when it is not inside it.
- `(valueChanged): { value: string | null; details: ChangeDetails }`: Heard as the day is about to change, typed or picked: `details.cancel()` keeps the value as it was.
- `(openChanged): { open: boolean; details: ChangeDetails }`: Heard as the calendar is about to open or close: `details.cancel()` keeps it as it was.
- `(monthChanged): { month: string; details: ChangeDetails }`: The calendar is about to show another month: its first day, and `details.cancel()`.

Each part, and its own props:

- `[kuiDatePicker]` is `KuiDatePicker`. `exportAs: "kuiDatePicker"`. A date field, and a calendar in a popover, with one value between them. On any element, or on `<ng-container>` to draw none. Inside it the date field's, the popover's and the calendar's own directives are its parts (`kuiDateFieldSegments`, `kuiPopoverTrigger`, `kuiCalendarGrid` …), with `kuiDatePickerField` and `kuiDatePickerCalendar` for the two elements that hold them. `[(value)]` is the day, `[(open)]` whether the calendar shows, `[(month)]` the first day of the month it shows. Its props are above.
- `[kuiDatePickerField]` is `KuiDatePickerField`. The typed date: what holds its segments and its hidden input.
- `[kuiDateFieldSegments]` is `KuiDateFieldSegments`. Structural: written `*kuiDateFieldSegments`. Its template is given the entry: `let entry` is a `DateFieldSegment`. `<span *kuiDateFieldSegments="let segment">`: once for each piece of the date.
- `[kuiDateFieldSegment]` is `KuiDateFieldSegment`. One piece: a part that is typed, or what stands between two. It writes its own text.
    - `segment: DateFieldSegment`: Required. The piece it is: an entry `DateField.Segments` gave.
- `input[kuiDateFieldInput]` is `KuiDateFieldInput`. `<input kuiDateFieldInput>`: the hidden input it is submitted by.
- `[kuiPopoverTrigger]` is `KuiPopoverTrigger`.
    - `openOnHover?: boolean`: Whether the pointer resting on the trigger opens the popover too. A press and the keyboard still open it, and a press on one the pointer opened keeps it open. Default `false`.
    - `delay?: number`: How long the pointer rests on the trigger before the popover opens, in milliseconds. Default 300.
    - `closeDelay?: number`: How long after the pointer leaves a popover it opened closes, in milliseconds. Default 0.
- `[kuiPopoverPortal]` is `KuiPopoverPortal`. Structural: written `*kuiPopoverPortal`. Draws what it holds at the end of `<body>`, or in the container a `PortalProvider` names.
- `[kuiPopoverPositioner]` is `KuiPopoverPositioner`. Takes the positioner options ("Positioner options", above).
- `[kuiPopoverPopup]` is `KuiPopoverPopup`.
- `[kuiDatePickerCalendar]` is `KuiDatePickerCalendar`. The calendar: what holds its heading, its buttons and its grid.
- `[kuiCalendarHeading]` is `KuiCalendarHeading`. Names the month shown: it writes the name before whatever is inside it.
- `[kuiCalendarPrevious]` is `KuiCalendarPrevious`.
- `[kuiCalendarNext]` is `KuiCalendarNext`.
- `[kuiCalendarMonths]` is `KuiCalendarMonths`. Structural: written `*kuiCalendarMonths`. Its template is given the entry: `let entry` is a `CalendarMonth`. `<div *kuiCalendarMonths="let month">`: once for each month shown, side by side. The parts inside each are that month's. Left out for one month.
- `[kuiCalendarGrid]` is `KuiCalendarGrid`. The table of a month's days: a grid the arrows move in, from one month shown into the next.
- `[kuiCalendarWeekdays]` is `KuiCalendarWeekdays`. Structural: written `*kuiCalendarWeekdays`. Its template is given the entry: `let entry` is a `CalendarWeekday`. `<th *kuiCalendarWeekdays="let weekday">`: once for each day of the week.
- `[kuiCalendarHeadCell]` is `KuiCalendarHeadCell`. A column's heading: a day of the week.
    - `weekday: CalendarWeekday`: Required. The day of the week it heads: an entry `Calendar.Weekdays` gave.
- `[kuiCalendarWeeks]` is `KuiCalendarWeeks`. Structural: written `*kuiCalendarWeeks`. Its template is given the entry: `let entry` is a `readonly CalendarDay[]`. `<tr *kuiCalendarWeeks="let week">`: once for each week of the month shown.
- `[kuiCalendarCell]` is `KuiCalendarCell`.
    - `date: string`: Required. The day it holds, as `Calendar.Weeks` gave it: `day.date`.
- `[kuiCalendarDay]` is `KuiCalendarDay`.
    - `date: string`: Required. The day it is the button of, as `Calendar.Weeks` gave it: `day.date`.

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- field: The field: a group of the date's parts.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-readonly`: Present when its value cannot be changed.
    - `data-invalid`: Present when the date is outside what it takes, or is asked for and half typed.
- segment: One piece of the date: a part that is typed, or what stands between two.
    - `data-segment="day | month | year | literal"`: Which piece it is.
    - `data-placeholder`: Present on a part that is empty.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-invalid`: Present when the date is outside what it takes, or is asked for and half typed.
- trigger: The button that opens the popover, and what it is placed against.
    - `data-popup-open`: Present when the popover is open.
- positioner: Places the popup against the trigger. It carries the geometry.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-side="top | right | bottom | left | inline-start | inline-end"`: The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip. Asked for as `inline-start` or `inline-end`, it says one of those two when it is beside its anchor.
    - `data-align="start | center | end"`: How it is aligned with the anchor.
    - `--anchor-width`: The anchor's width.
    - `--anchor-height`: The anchor's height.
    - `--available-width`: The width between the anchor and the edge of the viewport.
    - `--available-height`: The height between the anchor and the edge of the viewport.
    - `--transform-origin`: The point of the popup nearest its anchor, to scale from.
- popup: The popover itself.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-starting-style`: Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from.
    - `data-ending-style`: Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends.
    - `data-side="top | right | bottom | left | inline-start | inline-end"`: The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip. Asked for as `inline-start` or `inline-end`, it says one of those two when it is beside its anchor.
    - `data-align="start | center | end"`: How it is aligned with the anchor.
- calendar: The calendar.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-readonly`: Present when its value cannot be changed.
- previous: Shows the month before.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- next: Shows the month after.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- cell: A day's cell.
    - `data-selected`: Present on a chosen day, on every day of a chosen range, and on each day of a list. Never on a copy: a day of the month before or after shown in its own month too.
    - `data-today`: Present on today.
    - `data-outside-month`: Present on the days of the month before and after that fill the first and last weeks.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-unavailable`: Present on a day that cannot be chosen.
    - `data-range-start`: Present on the first day of a range.
    - `data-range-end`: Present on the last day of a range.
- day: The button for a day.
    - `data-selected`: Present on a chosen day, on every day of a chosen range, and on each day of a list. Never on a copy: a day of the month before or after shown in its own month too.
    - `data-today`: Present on today.
    - `data-outside-month`: Present on the days of the month before and after that fill the first and last weeks.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-unavailable`: Present on a day that cannot be chosen.
    - `data-range-start`: Present on the first day of a range.
    - `data-range-end`: Present on the last day of a range.

### Dialog

```
import { KuiDialog, KuiDialogTrigger, KuiDialogPortal, KuiDialogBackdrop, KuiDialogViewport, KuiDialogPopup, KuiDialogTitle, KuiDialogDescription, KuiDialogClose } from "@kirana-ui/angular"
```

Parts: `[kuiDialog]`, `[kuiDialogTrigger]`, `[kuiDialogPortal]`, `[kuiDialogBackdrop]`, `[kuiDialogViewport]`, `[kuiDialogPopup]`, `[kuiDialogTitle]`, `[kuiDialogDescription]`, `[kuiDialogClose]`.

Anatomy:

```
kuiDialog
  kuiDialogTrigger
  *kuiDialogPortal
    kuiDialogBackdrop
    kuiDialogViewport (optional)
      kuiDialogPopup
        kuiDialogTitle
        kuiDialogDescription
        kuiDialogClose
```

Props of its root:

- `[(open)]: boolean`: Whether it is open, when the caller holds it.
- `defaultOpen?: boolean`: Whether it starts open, when the caller does not hold `open`. Read once.
- `modal?: boolean`: Blocks the page behind it and traps focus. Default `true`.
- `dismissible?: boolean`: Whether a press outside closes it. Default `true`.
- `swipeDirection?: DrawerSide`: With `kuiDrawer`: the way it is dragged to close it. Default: `"down"`.
- `snapPoints?: readonly DrawerSnapPoint[]`: With `kuiDrawer`: places it rests at, each the share of itself that shows.
- `[(snapPoint)]: DrawerSnapPoint`: With `kuiDrawer`: which of them it rests at, `[(snapPoint)]`.
- `defaultSnapPoint?: DrawerSnapPoint`: With `kuiDrawer`: where it opens. Default: the smallest.
- `(snapPointChanged): { snapPoint: DrawerSnapPoint; details: ChangeDetails }`: With `kuiDrawer`: heard as it is about to rest at another snap point; `details.cancel()` keeps it where it was.
- `(openChanged): { open: boolean; details: ChangeDetails }`: Heard as it is about to open or close: `details.cancel()` keeps it as it was.

Each part, and its own props:

- `[kuiDialog]` is `KuiDialog`. `exportAs: "kuiDialog"`. On any element, or on `<ng-container>` to draw none. `kuiDrawer` in place of `kuiDialog` is a dialog that comes from an edge and is dragged back to it (`swipeDirection`): its parts are a dialog's (`kuiDialogPopup` …). An alert dialog has a root of its own, `kuiAlertDialog`. Its props are above.
- `[kuiDialogTrigger]` is `KuiDialogTrigger`.
- `[kuiDialogPortal]` is `KuiDialogPortal`. Structural: written `*kuiDialogPortal`. `<ng-template kuiDialogPortal>` or `*kuiDialogPortal`: its content at the end of the page while open.
- `[kuiDialogBackdrop]` is `KuiDialogBackdrop`.
- `[kuiDialogViewport]` is `KuiDialogViewport`. What a long dialog scrolls in, around its popup: it may be left out. A dialog's and an alert dialog's; a drawer lies at an edge of the page and has none.
- `[kuiDialogPopup]` is `KuiDialogPopup`.
- `[kuiDialogTitle]` is `KuiDialogTitle`. The heading that names the dialog.
- `[kuiDialogDescription]` is `KuiDialogDescription`. The text that describes the dialog.
- `[kuiDialogClose]` is `KuiDialogClose`. A button that closes the dialog.

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- trigger: The button that opens the dialog.
    - `data-popup-open`: Present when the dialog is open.
- backdrop: The layer over the page behind the dialog.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-starting-style`: Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from.
    - `data-ending-style`: Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends.
- viewport: What a long dialog scrolls in: it lies over the page, between the backdrop and the popup. A press on it beside the popup is a press outside the dialog; a press on its scrollbar is not.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-starting-style`: Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from.
    - `data-ending-style`: Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends.
    - `data-nested`: Present when the dialog opened over another dialog.
    - `data-nested-dialog-open`: Present when another dialog is open above this one.
- popup: The dialog itself.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-starting-style`: Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from.
    - `data-ending-style`: Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends.
    - `data-nested-dialog-open`: Present when another dialog is open above this one.
    - `--nested-dialogs`: How many dialogs are open above this one.

### Drawer

```
import { KuiDialog, KuiDialogTrigger, KuiDialogPortal, KuiDialogBackdrop, KuiDialogPopup, KuiDialogTitle, KuiDialogDescription, KuiDialogClose } from "@kirana-ui/angular"
```

Parts: `[kuiDrawer]`, `[kuiDialogTrigger]`, `[kuiDialogPortal]`, `[kuiDialogBackdrop]`, `[kuiDialogPopup]`, `[kuiDialogTitle]`, `[kuiDialogDescription]`, `[kuiDialogClose]`.

Anatomy:

```
kuiDrawer
  kuiDialogTrigger
  *kuiDialogPortal
    kuiDialogBackdrop
    kuiDialogPopup
      kuiDialogTitle
      kuiDialogDescription
      kuiDialogClose
```

Props of its root:

- `[(open)]: boolean`: Whether it is open, when the caller holds it.
- `defaultOpen?: boolean`: Whether it starts open, when the caller does not hold `open`. Read once.
- `modal?: boolean`: Blocks the page behind it and traps focus. Default `true`.
- `dismissible?: boolean`: Whether a press outside closes it. Default `true`.
- `swipeDirection?: DrawerSide`: With `kuiDrawer`: the way it is dragged to close it. Default: `"down"`.
- `snapPoints?: readonly DrawerSnapPoint[]`: With `kuiDrawer`: places it rests at, each the share of itself that shows.
- `[(snapPoint)]: DrawerSnapPoint`: With `kuiDrawer`: which of them it rests at, `[(snapPoint)]`.
- `defaultSnapPoint?: DrawerSnapPoint`: With `kuiDrawer`: where it opens. Default: the smallest.
- `(snapPointChanged): { snapPoint: DrawerSnapPoint; details: ChangeDetails }`: With `kuiDrawer`: heard as it is about to rest at another snap point; `details.cancel()` keeps it where it was.
- `(openChanged): { open: boolean; details: ChangeDetails }`: Heard as it is about to open or close: `details.cancel()` keeps it as it was.

Each part, and its own props:

- `[kuiDrawer]` is `KuiDialog`. `exportAs: "kuiDialog"`. On any element, or on `<ng-container>` to draw none. `kuiDrawer` in place of `kuiDialog` is a dialog that comes from an edge and is dragged back to it (`swipeDirection`): its parts are a dialog's (`kuiDialogPopup` …). An alert dialog has a root of its own, `kuiAlertDialog`. Its props are above.
- `[kuiDialogTrigger]` is `KuiDialogTrigger`.
- `[kuiDialogPortal]` is `KuiDialogPortal`. Structural: written `*kuiDialogPortal`. `<ng-template kuiDialogPortal>` or `*kuiDialogPortal`: its content at the end of the page while open.
- `[kuiDialogBackdrop]` is `KuiDialogBackdrop`.
- `[kuiDialogPopup]` is `KuiDialogPopup`.
- `[kuiDialogTitle]` is `KuiDialogTitle`. The heading that names the dialog.
- `[kuiDialogDescription]` is `KuiDialogDescription`. The text that describes the dialog.
- `[kuiDialogClose]` is `KuiDialogClose`. A button that closes the dialog.

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- trigger: The button that opens the dialog.
    - `data-popup-open`: Present when the dialog is open.
- backdrop: The layer over the page behind the dialog.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-starting-style`: Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from.
    - `data-ending-style`: Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends.
    - `data-swiping`: Present while the drawer is dragged.
    - `--drawer-swipe-movement-x`: How far it has been dragged across.
    - `--drawer-swipe-movement-y`: How far it has been dragged up or down.
    - `--drawer-swipe-progress`: How far it has been dragged, of its own size: 0 to 1.
    - `--drawer-snap-point-offset`: How far from whole it rests, towards the edge it closes at: 0px at its largest snap point.
- popup: The drawer. A design moves it by what it says of the drag, and gives it `touch-action: none` where a finger drags it.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-starting-style`: Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from.
    - `data-ending-style`: Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends.
    - `data-nested-dialog-open`: Present when another dialog is open above this one.
    - `data-swiping`: Present while the drawer is dragged.
    - `data-swipe-direction="up | down | left | right"`: The way it is dragged to close it.
    - `data-swipe-dismiss`: Present once a drag has closed it.
    - `data-expanded`: Present while it rests whole, of several snap points.
    - `data-nested-drawer-open`: Present while another drawer is open over it.
    - `data-nested-drawer-swiping`: Present while a drawer over it is dragged.
    - `--nested-dialogs`: How many dialogs are open above this one.
    - `--drawer-swipe-movement-x`: How far it has been dragged across.
    - `--drawer-swipe-movement-y`: How far it has been dragged up or down.
    - `--drawer-swipe-progress`: How far it has been dragged, of its own size: 0 to 1.
    - `--drawer-snap-point-offset`: How far from whole it rests, towards the edge it closes at: 0px at its largest snap point.
    - `--drawer-height`: Its height.
    - `--nested-drawers`: How many drawers are open over it.
    - `--drawer-frontmost-height`: The height of the drawer in front of every other, while this one is open.
    - `--drawer-swipe-strength`: Once let go: 0.1 to 1, the share of the design's own time it should take to come to rest. A drawer thrown hard arrives sooner.
    - `--drawer-width`: Its width.

### Field

```
import { KuiField, KuiFieldLabel, KuiFieldControl, KuiFieldDescription, KuiFieldError, KuiFieldValidity } from "@kirana-ui/angular"
```

Parts: `[kuiField]`, `[kuiFieldLabel]`, `[kuiFieldControl]`, `[kuiFieldDescription]`, `[kuiFieldError]`, `[kuiFieldValidity]`.

Anatomy:

```
kuiField
  kuiFieldLabel
  kuiFieldControl
  kuiFieldDescription
  *kuiFieldError
  *kuiFieldValidity
```

Props of its root:

- `name?: string`: The control's name in the form.
- `disabled?: boolean`: Disables the field: its control cannot be changed, and its parts say so (`data-disabled`).
- `invalid?: boolean`: Invalid whatever the value: an error known from elsewhere.
- `validate?: ( value: string ) => string | readonly string[] | null | Promise<string | readonly string[] | null>`: The field's own check, after the browser's: a message or several when the value is wrong, `null` when it is right. It may answer later, with a promise.
- `validationMode?: ValidationMode`: When the value is checked; the form's by default, else `"onSubmit"`.
- `validationDebounceTime?: number`: With `"onChange"`, how long the value must rest before it is checked, in milliseconds. Default `0`.

Each part, and its own props:

- `[kuiField]` is `KuiField`. `exportAs: "kuiField"`. Its props are above.
- `[kuiFieldLabel]` is `KuiFieldLabel`.
- `[kuiFieldControl]` is `KuiFieldControl`. On the control: an `<input>`, a `<textarea>` or a `<select>`.
- `[kuiFieldDescription]` is `KuiFieldDescription`.
- `[kuiFieldError]` is `KuiFieldError`. Structural: written `*kuiFieldError`. `<div *kuiFieldError>`: in the page while something is wrong, with the message as its text unless it has content of its own. `*kuiFieldError="'valueMissing'"` shows for only that finding of the browser's, `*kuiFieldError="true"` always.
    - `*kuiFieldError: ValidityKey | boolean | ""`: The directive's own value: `*kuiFieldError="…"`. One of the browser's findings (`"valueMissing"`) to show for only that; `true` to show always.
- `[kuiFieldValidity]` is `KuiFieldValidity`. Structural: written `*kuiFieldValidity`. Its template is given the entry: `let entry` is a `FieldValidity`. `<ng-container *kuiFieldValidity="let validity">`: draws its template with the field's validity.

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- root: A control with its label, its description and its errors.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-touched`: Present once focus has left the control.
    - `data-dirty`: Present while the value is not the one it started with.
    - `data-filled`: Present while the control has a value.
    - `data-focused`: Present while the control has focus.
    - `data-valid`: Present once the value has been checked and found right.
    - `data-invalid`: Present while the value is wrong.
- label: The control's name: a press on it reaches the control.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-touched`: Present once focus has left the control.
    - `data-dirty`: Present while the value is not the one it started with.
    - `data-filled`: Present while the control has a value.
    - `data-focused`: Present while the control has focus.
    - `data-valid`: Present once the value has been checked and found right.
    - `data-invalid`: Present while the value is wrong.
- control: The control: an input, a textarea or a select.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-touched`: Present once focus has left the control.
    - `data-dirty`: Present while the value is not the one it started with.
    - `data-filled`: Present while the control has a value.
    - `data-focused`: Present while the control has focus.
    - `data-valid`: Present once the value has been checked and found right.
    - `data-invalid`: Present while the value is wrong.
- description: More about the control, said after its name.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-touched`: Present once focus has left the control.
    - `data-dirty`: Present while the value is not the one it started with.
    - `data-filled`: Present while the control has a value.
    - `data-focused`: Present while the control has focus.
    - `data-valid`: Present once the value has been checked and found right.
    - `data-invalid`: Present while the value is wrong.
- error: What is wrong with the value. In the page while it applies.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-touched`: Present once focus has left the control.
    - `data-dirty`: Present while the value is not the one it started with.
    - `data-filled`: Present while the control has a value.
    - `data-focused`: Present while the control has focus.
    - `data-valid`: Present once the value has been checked and found right.
    - `data-invalid`: Present while the value is wrong.
    - `data-starting-style`: Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from.
    - `data-ending-style`: Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends.

### Fieldset

```
import { KuiFieldset, KuiFieldsetLegend } from "@kirana-ui/angular"
```

```
kuiFieldset
  kuiFieldsetLegend
```

- `disabled?: boolean`: Disables every field inside.

Each part, and its own props:

- `[kuiFieldset]` is `KuiFieldset`. `exportAs: "kuiFieldset"`. Its props are above.
- `[kuiFieldsetLegend]` is `KuiFieldsetLegend`.

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

### Form

```
import { KuiForm } from "@kirana-ui/angular"
```

Props:

- `errors?: FormErrors`: Errors from outside the page (a server's), by field name. A field shows its own until its value changes.
- `validationMode?: ValidationMode`: When the form's fields check their values, unless a field says otherwise. Default `"onSubmit"`.
- `(formSubmit): { values: FormValues; details: ChangeDetails }`: Every field is valid. Given this, the page is not left: the values come as an object. Without it, the form submits as a form does.
- `(clearErrors): FormErrors`: A field's value changed while it showed one of `errors`: what is left of them.

`form[kuiForm]` is `KuiForm`. `exportAs: "kuiForm"`. On a `<form>`: its fields say what is wrong, and `(formSubmit)` gives the values once all are valid. As with Angular's own forms, the page is left only when the form has an `action`.

### HoverCard

```
import { KuiHoverCard, KuiHoverCardTrigger, KuiHoverCardPortal, KuiHoverCardPositioner, KuiHoverCardPopup, KuiHoverCardArrow } from "@kirana-ui/angular"
```

Parts: `[kuiHoverCard]`, `[kuiHoverCardTrigger]`, `[kuiHoverCardPortal]`, `[kuiHoverCardPositioner]`, `[kuiHoverCardPopup]`, `[kuiHoverCardArrow]`.

Anatomy:

```
kuiHoverCard
  kuiHoverCardTrigger
  *kuiHoverCardPortal
    kuiHoverCardPositioner
      kuiHoverCardPopup
        kuiHoverCardArrow
```

Props of its root:

- `[(open)]: boolean`: Whether it is open, when the caller holds it.
- `defaultOpen?: boolean`: Whether it starts open, when the caller does not hold `open`. Read once.
- `delay?: number`: How long the pointer rests on the trigger before the popup opens, in milliseconds. Default `600`.
- `closeDelay?: number`: How long after the pointer leaves the popup closes, in milliseconds. Default `300`.
- `disabled?: boolean`: Disabled: the pointer and focus do not open it.
- `(openChanged): { open: boolean; details: ChangeDetails }`: The change with why it happened; `details.cancel()` keeps the value.

Each part, and its own props:

- `[kuiHoverCard]` is `KuiHoverCard`. `exportAs: "kuiHoverCard"`. On any element, or on `<ng-container>` to draw none. Its props are above.
- `[kuiHoverCardTrigger]` is `KuiHoverCardTrigger`.
    - `delay?: number`: Its own waits, which come before the root's.
    - `closeDelay?: number`: How long after the pointer leaves this trigger's popup closes, in milliseconds.
- `[kuiHoverCardPortal]` is `KuiHoverCardPortal`. Structural: written `*kuiHoverCardPortal`. Draws what it holds at the end of `<body>`, or in the container a `PortalProvider` names.
- `[kuiHoverCardPositioner]` is `KuiHoverCardPositioner`. Takes the positioner options ("Positioner options", above).
- `[kuiHoverCardPopup]` is `KuiHoverCardPopup`.
- `[kuiHoverCardArrow]` is `KuiHoverCardArrow`.

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- trigger: The link the card previews.
    - `data-popup-open`: Present when the card is open.
- positioner: Places the popup against the trigger. It carries the geometry.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-side="top | right | bottom | left | inline-start | inline-end"`: The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip. Asked for as `inline-start` or `inline-end`, it says one of those two when it is beside its anchor.
    - `data-align="start | center | end"`: How it is aligned with the anchor.
    - `--anchor-width`: The anchor's width.
    - `--anchor-height`: The anchor's height.
    - `--available-width`: The width between the anchor and the edge of the viewport.
    - `--available-height`: The height between the anchor and the edge of the viewport.
    - `--transform-origin`: The point of the popup nearest its anchor, to scale from.
- popup: The card itself.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-starting-style`: Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from.
    - `data-ending-style`: Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends.
    - `data-side="top | right | bottom | left | inline-start | inline-end"`: The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip. Asked for as `inline-start` or `inline-end`, it says one of those two when it is beside its anchor.
    - `data-align="start | center | end"`: How it is aligned with the anchor.
    - `data-instant="delay | focus | dismiss"`: Present when it opened or closed without its usual wait, for a design that skips the motion then.
- arrow: An element that points at the trigger, placed along the popup's edge.
    - `data-side="top | right | bottom | left | inline-start | inline-end"`: The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip. Asked for as `inline-start` or `inline-end`, it says one of those two when it is beside its anchor.
    - `data-align="start | center | end"`: How it is aligned with the anchor.
    - `data-uncentered`: Present when the popup was pushed along its edge, so the arrow is not at the trigger's centre.

### Input

```
import { KuiInput } from "@kirana-ui/angular"
```

Props:

- `disabled?: boolean`: Disabled: nothing can be typed in it.
- `(valueChanged): { value: string; details: ChangeDetails }`: What was typed, as text, each time it changes.

`[kuiInput]` is `KuiInput`. `exportAs: "kuiInput"`. `<input kuiInput>` or `<textarea kuiInput>`: it says its state, and inside a `kuiField` it is the field's control. Its value is the element's own (`[value]`, `ngModel`).

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- input: A text input. Inside a field it is the field's control.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-touched`: Present once focus has left the input.
    - `data-dirty`: Present while the value is not the one it started with.
    - `data-filled`: Present while the input has a value.
    - `data-focused`: Present while the input has focus.
    - `data-valid`: In a field: present once the value was checked and found right.
    - `data-invalid`: In a field: present while the value is wrong.

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:
