### Listbox

```
import { KuiListbox, KuiListboxItem, KuiListboxItemIndicator, KuiListboxGroup, KuiListboxGroupLabel } from "@kirana-ui/angular"
```

Parts: `[kuiListbox]`, `[kuiListboxItem]`, `[kuiListboxItemIndicator]`, `[kuiListboxGroup]`, `[kuiListboxGroupLabel]`.

Anatomy:

```
kuiListbox
  kuiListboxGroup (optional, repeated)
    kuiListboxItem (repeated)
      *kuiListboxItemIndicator
    kuiListboxGroupLabel
```

Props of its root:

- `[(value)]: readonly Value[]`: The chosen values: none, one, or with `multiple` several.
- `defaultValue?: readonly Value[]`: The values it starts with, when the caller does not hold `value`. Read once.
- `multiple?: boolean`: Whether more than one can be chosen: a press then adds or takes away.
- `disabled?: boolean`: Disabled: no item can be chosen.
- `loop?: boolean`: Whether the arrows go round from the last item to the first. Default: they do not.
- `name?: string`: With a name, the chosen values are submitted with the form around the list.
- `form?: string`: The id of the form the list belongs to, when it is not inside it.
- `virtualized?: ListCollection`: Every row, when only some are in the page: each item is then given its `index`.
- `(valueChanged): { value: Value[]; details: ChangeDetails }`: Heard as an item is about to be chosen or taken away, with the values there would then be: `details.cancel()` keeps them as they were.

Each part, and its own props:

- `[kuiListbox]` is `KuiListbox`. `exportAs: "kuiListbox"`. Generic: `<Value = unknown>`. Its props are above.
- `[kuiListboxItem]` is `KuiListboxItem`.
    - `value: unknown`: Required. What is in the listbox's value while this item is chosen.
    - `disabled?: boolean`: Disables this item: it cannot be chosen, and the arrows pass over it.
    - `label?: string`: What typing matches; the item's text when left out.
    - `index?: number`: Its place among all the rows, in a virtualized list.
- `[kuiListboxItemIndicator]` is `KuiListboxItemIndicator`. Structural: written `*kuiListboxItemIndicator`. `<span *kuiListboxItemIndicator>`: in the page while its item is chosen.
- `[kuiListboxGroup]` is `KuiListboxGroup`. Items that belong together, named by their label.
- `[kuiListboxGroupLabel]` is `KuiListboxGroupLabel`. The name of a group.

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- root: The list. It is one stop for Tab.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- item: One choice in the list.
    - `data-selected`: Present on a chosen item.
    - `data-highlighted`: Present on the item the keyboard is on.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- itemIndicator: A mark an item shows while it is chosen.
    - `data-selected`: Present on a chosen item.

### Menu

```
import { KuiMenu, KuiMenuTrigger, KuiMenuPortal, KuiMenuPositioner, KuiMenuPopup, KuiMenuArrow, KuiMenuItem, KuiMenuLinkItem, KuiMenuGroup, KuiMenuGroupLabel, KuiMenuSeparator, KuiMenuCheckboxItem, KuiMenuCheckboxItemIndicator, KuiMenuRadioGroup, KuiMenuRadioItem, KuiMenuRadioItemIndicator, KuiMenuSubmenuRoot, KuiMenuSubmenuTrigger } from "@kirana-ui/angular"
```

Parts: `[kuiMenu]`, `[kuiMenuTrigger]`, `[kuiMenuPortal]`, `[kuiMenuPositioner]`, `[kuiMenuPopup]`, `[kuiMenuArrow]`, `[kuiMenuItem]`, `a[kuiMenuLinkItem]`, `[kuiMenuGroup]`, `[kuiMenuGroupLabel]`, `[kuiMenuSeparator]`, `[kuiMenuCheckboxItem]`, `[kuiMenuCheckboxItemIndicator]`, `[kuiMenuRadioGroup]`, `[kuiMenuRadioItem]`, `[kuiMenuRadioItemIndicator]`, `[kuiMenuSubmenuRoot]`, `[kuiMenuSubmenuTrigger]`.

Anatomy:

```
kuiMenu
  kuiMenuTrigger
  *kuiMenuPortal
    kuiMenuPositioner
      kuiMenuPopup
        kuiMenuArrow
        kuiMenuGroup (optional, repeated)
          kuiMenuItem (repeated)
          a[kuiMenuLinkItem] (repeated)
          kuiMenuGroupLabel
          kuiMenuCheckboxItem (repeated)
            *kuiMenuCheckboxItemIndicator
          kuiMenuRadioGroup (repeated)
            kuiMenuRadioItem (repeated)
              *kuiMenuRadioItemIndicator
          kuiMenuSubmenuRoot (repeated)
            *kuiMenuPortal (as above)
            kuiMenuSubmenuTrigger
        kuiMenuSeparator (repeated)
```

Props of its root:

- `[(open)]: boolean`: Whether it is open, when the caller holds it.
- `defaultOpen?: boolean`: Whether it starts open, when the caller does not hold `open`. Read once.
- `disabled?: boolean`: The trigger cannot be pressed; a submenu's is passed over.
- `loop?: boolean`: Whether the arrows go round from the last item to the first. Default: they do.
- `modal?: boolean`: Holds the page while the menu is open. Not for a submenu.
- `(openChanged): { open: boolean; details: ChangeDetails }`: Heard as it is about to open or close: `details.cancel()` keeps it as it was.

Each part, and its own props:

- `[kuiMenu]` is `KuiMenu`. `exportAs: "kuiMenu"`. `kuiContextMenu` in place of `kuiMenu` is a menu for an area of the page, opened at the pointer: its trigger is `kuiContextMenuTrigger`, its other parts the menu's. Its props are above.
- `[kuiMenuTrigger]` is `KuiMenuTrigger`.
- `[kuiMenuPortal]` is `KuiMenuPortal`. Structural: written `*kuiMenuPortal`. Draws what it holds at the end of `<body>`, or in the container a `PortalProvider` names.
- `[kuiMenuPositioner]` is `KuiMenuPositioner`. Takes the positioner options ("Positioner options", above).
- `[kuiMenuPopup]` is `KuiMenuPopup`.
- `[kuiMenuArrow]` is `KuiMenuArrow`.
- `[kuiMenuItem]` is `KuiMenuItem`.
    - `disabled?: boolean`: Disables this item: it cannot be pressed, and the arrows pass over it.
    - `label?: string`: What typing matches; the item's text when left out.
    - `closeOnClick?: boolean`: Whether choosing the item closes the menu. Default: it does.
- `a[kuiMenuLinkItem]` is `KuiMenuLinkItem`. `<a kuiMenuLinkItem href="…">`: an item that is a link.
    - `disabled?: boolean`: Disables this item: it cannot be pressed, and the arrows pass over it.
    - `label?: string`: What typing matches; the item's text when left out.
    - `closeOnClick?: boolean`: Whether choosing the item closes the menu. Default: it does.
- `[kuiMenuGroup]` is `KuiMenuGroup`. Items that belong together, named by their label.
- `[kuiMenuGroupLabel]` is `KuiMenuGroupLabel`. Names the group it is in. With no group around it, it is plain text.
- `[kuiMenuSeparator]` is `KuiMenuSeparator`. A line between items.
- `[kuiMenuCheckboxItem]` is `KuiMenuCheckboxItem`. `exportAs: "kuiMenuCheckboxItem"`.
    - `[(checked)]: boolean`: Whether the item is checked, when the caller holds it.
    - `defaultChecked?: boolean`: Whether the item starts checked, when the caller does not hold `checked`. Read once.
    - `disabled?: boolean`: Disables this item: it cannot be pressed, and the arrows pass over it.
    - `label?: string`: What typing matches; the item's text when left out.
    - `closeOnClick?: boolean`: Whether choosing the item closes the menu. Default: it does not.
    - `(checkedChanged): { checked: boolean; details: ChangeDetails }`: Heard as the item is about to be checked or unchecked: `details.cancel()` keeps it as it was.
- `[kuiMenuCheckboxItemIndicator]` is `KuiMenuCheckboxItemIndicator`. Structural: written `*kuiMenuCheckboxItemIndicator`. `<span *kuiMenuCheckboxItemIndicator>`: in the page while its item is checked.
- `[kuiMenuRadioGroup]` is `KuiMenuRadioGroup`. `exportAs: "kuiMenuRadioGroup"`. Generic: `<Value = unknown>`.
    - `[(value)]: Value | null`: The chosen value; `null` is "none".
    - `defaultValue?: NoInfer<Value> | null`: The value it starts with, when the caller does not hold `value`. Read once.
    - `disabled?: boolean`: Disables every item of the group.
    - `(valueChanged): { value: Value; details: ChangeDetails }`: Told an item's own value, never `null`: a press chooses, and nothing takes the choice back.
- `[kuiMenuRadioItem]` is `KuiMenuRadioItem`.
    - `value: unknown`: Required. What the radio group's value is while this item is the chosen one.
    - `disabled?: boolean`: Disables this item: it cannot be pressed, and the arrows pass over it.
    - `label?: string`: What typing matches; the item's text when left out.
    - `closeOnClick?: boolean`: Whether choosing the item closes the menu. Default: it does not.
- `[kuiMenuRadioItemIndicator]` is `KuiMenuRadioItemIndicator`. Structural: written `*kuiMenuRadioItemIndicator`. `<span *kuiMenuRadioItemIndicator>`: in the page while its item is the chosen one.
- `[kuiMenuSubmenuRoot]` is `KuiMenuSubmenuRoot`. `exportAs: "kuiMenuSubmenuRoot"`. A menu that one of this menu's items opens. Its trigger is `kuiMenuSubmenuTrigger`.
    - `[(open)]: boolean`: Whether it is open, when the caller holds it.
    - `defaultOpen?: boolean`: Whether it starts open, when the caller does not hold `open`. Read once.
    - `disabled?: boolean`: The trigger cannot be pressed; a submenu's is passed over.
    - `loop?: boolean`: Whether the arrows go round from the last item to the first. Default: they do.
    - `modal?: boolean`: Holds the page while the menu is open. Not for a submenu.
    - `(openChanged): { open: boolean; details: ChangeDetails }`: Heard as it is about to open or close: `details.cancel()` keeps it as it was.
- `[kuiMenuSubmenuTrigger]` is `KuiMenuSubmenuTrigger`. On the item of a menu that opens the submenu around it (`kuiMenuSubmenuRoot`).

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- trigger: The button that opens the menu, and what it is placed against.
    - `data-popup-open`: Present when the menu is open.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- positioner: Places the menu against its trigger. It carries the geometry.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-side="top | right | bottom | left | inline-start | inline-end"`: The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip. Asked for as `inline-start` or `inline-end`, it says one of those two when it is beside its anchor.
    - `data-align="start | center | end"`: How it is aligned with the anchor.
    - `--anchor-width`: The anchor's width.
    - `--anchor-height`: The anchor's height.
    - `--available-width`: The width between the anchor and the edge of the viewport.
    - `--available-height`: The height between the anchor and the edge of the viewport.
    - `--transform-origin`: The point of the popup nearest its anchor, to scale from.
- popup: The menu itself: the list of items.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-starting-style`: Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from.
    - `data-ending-style`: Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends.
    - `data-side="top | right | bottom | left | inline-start | inline-end"`: The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip. Asked for as `inline-start` or `inline-end`, it says one of those two when it is beside its anchor.
    - `data-align="start | center | end"`: How it is aligned with the anchor.
- arrow: An element that points at the trigger.
    - `data-side="top | right | bottom | left | inline-start | inline-end"`: The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip. Asked for as `inline-start` or `inline-end`, it says one of those two when it is beside its anchor.
    - `data-align="start | center | end"`: How it is aligned with the anchor.
    - `data-uncentered`: Present when the arrow cannot sit at the trigger's centre.
- item: An action. Choosing it closes the menu.
    - `data-highlighted`: Present on the item the pointer or the keyboard is on.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- linkItem: An item that is a link. Choosing it follows the link and closes the menu.
    - `data-highlighted`: Present on the item the pointer or the keyboard is on.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- checkboxItem: An item that is checked or not. Choosing it leaves the menu open.
    - `data-checked`: Present when it is checked.
    - `data-unchecked`: Present when it is not checked.
    - `data-highlighted`: Present on the item the pointer or the keyboard is on.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- checkboxItemIndicator: A mark a checkbox item shows while it is checked.
    - `data-checked`: Present when it is checked.
    - `data-unchecked`: Present when it is not checked.
- radioGroup: Radio items of which one is chosen.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- radioItem: One choice of a radio group. Choosing it leaves the menu open.
    - `data-checked`: Present when it is checked.
    - `data-unchecked`: Present when it is not checked.
    - `data-highlighted`: Present on the item the pointer or the keyboard is on.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- radioItemIndicator: A mark a radio item shows while it is the chosen one.
    - `data-checked`: Present when it is checked.
    - `data-unchecked`: Present when it is not checked.
- submenuTrigger: An item that opens a menu beside it.
    - `data-popup-open`: Present when its menu is open.
    - `data-highlighted`: Present on the item the pointer or the keyboard is on.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.

### Menubar

```
import { KuiMenubar } from "@kirana-ui/angular"
```

Props:

- `loop?: boolean`: Whether the arrows go round from the last menu to the first. Default: they do.
- `disabled?: boolean`: No menu of the bar opens.
- `orientation?: Orientation`: A row (the default) or a column of menus. In a column a menu opens beside its trigger.

`[kuiMenubar]` is `KuiMenubar`. `exportAs: "kuiMenubar"`. A row of menus that work as one. Each `kuiMenu` inside it is one of its items.

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- root: The row of menus. A menu inside it is one of its items.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-orientation="horizontal | vertical"`: Whether its menus are in a row or a column.

### MessageScroller

```
import { KuiMessageScroller, KuiMessageScrollerViewport, KuiMessageScrollerContent, KuiMessageScrollerButton } from "@kirana-ui/angular"
```

Parts: `[kuiMessageScroller]`, `[kuiMessageScrollerViewport]`, `[kuiMessageScrollerContent]`, `[kuiMessageScrollerButton]`.

Anatomy:

```
kuiMessageScroller
  kuiMessageScrollerViewport
    kuiMessageScrollerContent
  kuiMessageScrollerButton
```

Props of its root:

- `initial?: "bottom" | "top"`: Where it begins: at the newest message (the default), or at the first.
- `threshold?: number`: How near the end counts as at it, in pixels. Default: 24.
- `(atBottomChanged): { atBottom: boolean; details: ChangeDetails }`: It came to the end, or left it.

Each part, and its own props:

- `[kuiMessageScroller]` is `KuiMessageScroller`. `exportAs: "kuiMessageScroller"`. Its props are above.
- `[kuiMessageScrollerViewport]` is `KuiMessageScrollerViewport`.
- `[kuiMessageScrollerContent]` is `KuiMessageScrollerContent`. The messages: what grows as one is written.
- `[kuiMessageScrollerButton]` is `KuiMessageScrollerButton`.

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- root: What holds the conversation and its button.
    - `data-at-bottom`: Present while the newest message is in view.
- viewport: What scrolls: a log, reached by the keyboard.
    - `data-at-bottom`: Present while the newest message is in view.
- button: Goes to the newest message. Inert while that is in view.
    - `data-at-bottom`: Present while the newest message is in view.

### Meter

```
import { KuiMeter, KuiMeterTrack, KuiMeterIndicator, KuiMeterValue, KuiMeterLabel } from "@kirana-ui/angular"
```
