```
kuiMeter
  kuiMeterTrack
    kuiMeterIndicator
  kuiMeterValue
  kuiMeterLabel
```

Props of its root:

- `value: number`: Required. The measure, between `min` and `max`. A meter always has one.
- `min?: number`: Default 0.
- `max?: number`: Default 100.
- `format?: Intl.NumberFormatOptions`: How the value is written; a percentage of the range by default.
- `locale?: string`: The language the value is written in; the page's by default.
- `getAriaValueText?: (text: string | undefined, value: number | null) => string`: What assistive technology reads for the value, when the written value is not enough.

Each part, and its own props:

- `[kuiMeter]` is `KuiMeter`. `exportAs: "kuiMeter"`. The meter: it says the value to assistive technology. Its props are above.
- `[kuiMeterTrack]` is `KuiMeterTrack`. The whole range.
- `[kuiMeterIndicator]` is `KuiMeterIndicator`. The filled part: its width is the value's share of the range.
- `[kuiMeterValue]` is `KuiMeterValue`. Shows the written value.
- `[kuiMeterLabel]` is `KuiMeterLabel`. The meter's name.

### NavigationMenu

```
import { KuiNavigationMenu, KuiNavigationMenuList, KuiNavigationMenuItem, KuiNavigationMenuTrigger, KuiNavigationMenuIcon, KuiNavigationMenuContent, KuiNavigationMenuLink, KuiNavigationMenuPortal, KuiNavigationMenuPositioner, KuiNavigationMenuPopup, KuiNavigationMenuViewport, KuiNavigationMenuArrow, KuiNavigationMenuBackdrop } from "@kirana-ui/angular"
```

Parts: `[kuiNavigationMenu]`, `[kuiNavigationMenuList]`, `[kuiNavigationMenuItem]`, `[kuiNavigationMenuTrigger]`, `[kuiNavigationMenuIcon]`, `[kuiNavigationMenuContent]`, `[kuiNavigationMenuLink]`, `[kuiNavigationMenuPortal]`, `[kuiNavigationMenuPositioner]`, `[kuiNavigationMenuPopup]`, `[kuiNavigationMenuViewport]`, `[kuiNavigationMenuArrow]`, `[kuiNavigationMenuBackdrop]`.

Anatomy:

```
kuiNavigationMenu
  kuiNavigationMenuList
    kuiNavigationMenuItem (repeated)
      kuiNavigationMenuTrigger
        kuiNavigationMenuIcon
      *kuiNavigationMenuContent
        kuiNavigationMenuLink (repeated)
      kuiNavigationMenuLink (repeated, as above)
    kuiNavigationMenuLink (repeated, as above)
  *kuiNavigationMenuPortal
    kuiNavigationMenuPositioner
      kuiNavigationMenuPopup
        kuiNavigationMenuViewport
        kuiNavigationMenuArrow
    kuiNavigationMenuBackdrop
```

Props of its root:

- `[(value)]: Value | null`: The item whose content is shown; `null` is "none".
- `defaultValue?: NoInfer<Value> | null`: The item whose content it starts with, when the caller does not hold `value`. Read once.
- `delay?: number`: How long the pointer rests on a trigger before its content shows, in milliseconds. Default `50`.
- `closeDelay?: number`: How long after the pointer leaves the content goes, in milliseconds. Default `50`.
- `orientation?: Orientation`: Whether the triggers are laid out across (the default) or down: the arrows that move between them follow.
- `(valueChanged): { value: Value | null; details: ChangeDetails }`: Heard as another item's content is about to show, or none: `details.cancel()` keeps the value as it was.

Each part, and its own props:

- `[kuiNavigationMenu]` is `KuiNavigationMenu`. `exportAs: "kuiNavigationMenu"`. Generic: `<Value = unknown>`. Its props are above.
- `[kuiNavigationMenuList]` is `KuiNavigationMenuList`.
- `[kuiNavigationMenuItem]` is `KuiNavigationMenuItem`. On an item's `<li>`. `value` tells it from the others; an item that is given none makes its own.
    - `value?: unknown`: What tells this item from the others: the menu's `value` while its content is shown. An item that is given none makes its own.
- `[kuiNavigationMenuTrigger]` is `KuiNavigationMenuTrigger`.
- `[kuiNavigationMenuIcon]` is `KuiNavigationMenuIcon`.
- `[kuiNavigationMenuContent]` is `KuiNavigationMenuContent`. Structural: written `*kuiNavigationMenuContent`. `<div *kuiNavigationMenuContent>`: an item's content, drawn in `kuiNavigationMenuViewport` while it is shown.
- `[kuiNavigationMenuLink]` is `KuiNavigationMenuLink`.
    - `active?: boolean`: The link is the page the reader is on.
    - `closeOnClick?: boolean`: Whether following it closes the menu. Default: it does.
- `[kuiNavigationMenuPortal]` is `KuiNavigationMenuPortal`. Structural: written `*kuiNavigationMenuPortal`. Draws what it holds at the end of `<body>`, or in the container a `PortalProvider` names.
- `[kuiNavigationMenuPositioner]` is `KuiNavigationMenuPositioner`. Takes the positioner options ("Positioner options", above).
- `[kuiNavigationMenuPopup]` is `KuiNavigationMenuPopup`.
- `[kuiNavigationMenuViewport]` is `KuiNavigationMenuViewport`. Where the contents are drawn, inside the popup.
- `[kuiNavigationMenuArrow]` is `KuiNavigationMenuArrow`.
- `[kuiNavigationMenuBackdrop]` is `KuiNavigationMenuBackdrop`.

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- root: The navigation.
    - `data-orientation="horizontal | vertical"`: Whether the list is a row or a column.
- list: The row of items.
    - `data-orientation="horizontal | vertical"`: Whether the list is a row or a column.
- trigger: The button that shows an item's content.
    - `data-popup-open`: Present while the item's content is shown.
- icon: A mark on a trigger that shows whether its content is open.
    - `data-popup-open`: Present while the item's content is shown.
- content: What an item shows. It is drawn in the viewport every item shares.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-starting-style`: Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from.
    - `data-ending-style`: Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends.
    - `data-activation-direction="left | right"`: Which way it came from: the item before it, or after.
- link: A link, in the list or in an item's content.
    - `data-active`: Present on the link of the page the reader is on.
- positioner: Places the popup against the open item's trigger. It carries the geometry.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-side="top | right | bottom | left | inline-start | inline-end"`: The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip. Asked for as `inline-start` or `inline-end`, it says one of those two when it is beside its anchor.
    - `data-align="start | center | end"`: How it is aligned with the anchor.
    - `--anchor-width`: The anchor's width.
    - `--anchor-height`: The anchor's height.
    - `--available-width`: The width between the anchor and the edge of the viewport.
    - `--available-height`: The height between the anchor and the edge of the viewport.
    - `--transform-origin`: The point of the popup nearest its anchor, to scale from.
    - `--positioner-width`: The open content's width.
    - `--positioner-height`: The open content's height.
- popup: The panel every item's content is shown in.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-starting-style`: Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from.
    - `data-ending-style`: Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends.
    - `data-side="top | right | bottom | left | inline-start | inline-end"`: The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip. Asked for as `inline-start` or `inline-end`, it says one of those two when it is beside its anchor.
    - `data-align="start | center | end"`: How it is aligned with the anchor.
    - `--popup-width`: The open content's width.
    - `--popup-height`: The open content's height.
- arrow: An element that points at the open item's trigger.
    - `data-side="top | right | bottom | left | inline-start | inline-end"`: The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip. Asked for as `inline-start` or `inline-end`, it says one of those two when it is beside its anchor.
    - `data-align="start | center | end"`: How it is aligned with the anchor.
    - `data-uncentered`: Present when the arrow cannot sit at the trigger's centre.
- backdrop: An element behind the popup, for a design that dims the page.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-starting-style`: Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from.
    - `data-ending-style`: Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends.

### NumberField

```
import { KuiNumberField, KuiNumberFieldGroup, KuiNumberFieldInput, KuiNumberFieldIncrement, KuiNumberFieldDecrement, KuiNumberFieldScrubArea, KuiNumberFieldScrubAreaCursor } from "@kirana-ui/angular"
```

Parts: `[kuiNumberField]`, `[kuiNumberFieldGroup]`, `[kuiNumberFieldInput]`, `[kuiNumberFieldIncrement]`, `[kuiNumberFieldDecrement]`, `[kuiNumberFieldScrubArea]`, `[kuiNumberFieldScrubAreaCursor]`.

Anatomy:

```
kuiNumberField
  kuiNumberFieldGroup
    kuiNumberFieldInput
    kuiNumberFieldIncrement
    kuiNumberFieldDecrement
  kuiNumberFieldScrubArea
    *kuiNumberFieldScrubAreaCursor
```

Props of its root:

- `[(value)]: number | null`: The number; `null` is "none".
- `defaultValue?: number | null`: The value it starts with, when the caller does not hold `value`. Read once.
- `min?: number`: The least the number may be.
- `max?: number`: The most the number may be.
- `step?: number`: What the buttons and the arrows move by. Default 1.
- `smallStep?: number`: With Alt held. Default 0.1.
- `largeStep?: number`: With Shift held. Default 10.
- `snapOnStep?: boolean`: A step lands on a multiple of the step, counted from `min`.
- `allowWheelScrub?: boolean`: The wheel steps it while the pointer is over the input and focus is in it.
- `format?: Intl.NumberFormatOptions`: How the number is written.
- `locale?: string`: The language it is written in; the page's by default.
- `disabled?: boolean`: Disabled: it cannot be changed.
- `readOnly?: boolean`: Shown as it is, focusable, not changeable.
- `required?: boolean`: Needed: in a `Field`, leaving it empty is then invalid.
- `name?: string`: With a name, the number is submitted with the form around it.
- `form?: string`: The id of the form the control belongs to, when it is not inside it.
- `(valueChanged): { value: number | null; details: ChangeDetails }`: Heard as the number is about to change, typed or stepped: `details.cancel()` keeps it as it was.
- `(valueCommitted): { value: number | null; details: ChangeDetails }`: A change that is done: focus left the input, a key or a button stepped it.

Each part, and its own props:

- `[kuiNumberField]` is `KuiNumberField`. `exportAs: "kuiNumberField"`. On the element that holds the field's parts. `[(value)]` is the number, `null` for none. With a name, it draws the hidden input a form reads. Its props are above.
- `[kuiNumberFieldGroup]` is `KuiNumberFieldGroup`.
- `[kuiNumberFieldInput]` is `KuiNumberFieldInput`.
- `[kuiNumberFieldIncrement]` is `KuiNumberFieldIncrement`.
- `[kuiNumberFieldDecrement]` is `KuiNumberFieldDecrement`.
- `[kuiNumberFieldScrubArea]` is `KuiNumberFieldScrubArea`. On the element that is pressed and dragged to change the number: the field's label, as a rule.
    - `direction?: "horizontal" | "vertical"`: The way the pointer is dragged: `"horizontal"`, where right is more, or `"vertical"`, where up is more. Default `"horizontal"`.
    - `pixelSensitivity?: number`: How many pixels the pointer moves before the number changes. Default 2.
    - `teleportDistance?: number`: How far past the area's edges the drawn cursor goes before it comes back in at the other side. Default: the edges of the window.
- `[kuiNumberFieldScrubAreaCursor]` is `KuiNumberFieldScrubAreaCursor`. Structural: written `*kuiNumberFieldScrubAreaCursor`. `<span *kuiNumberFieldScrubAreaCursor>`: drawn in place of the pointer while it is locked for a drag, at the end of the page.

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- root: Groups the number field's parts.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-readonly`: Present when the number cannot be changed.
    - `data-required`: Present when a number must be given.
    - `data-touched`: Present once focus has left the input.
    - `data-dirty`: Present while the number is not the one it started with.
    - `data-filled`: Present while there is a number.
    - `data-focused`: Present while the input has focus.
    - `data-scrubbing`: Present while the number is dragged from its scrub area.
    - `data-valid`: In a field: present once the number was checked and found right.
    - `data-invalid`: In a field: present while the number is wrong.
- group: What holds the input and its buttons, as one control.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-readonly`: Present when the number cannot be changed.
    - `data-required`: Present when a number must be given.
    - `data-touched`: Present once focus has left the input.
    - `data-dirty`: Present while the number is not the one it started with.
    - `data-filled`: Present while there is a number.
    - `data-focused`: Present while the input has focus.
    - `data-scrubbing`: Present while the number is dragged from its scrub area.
    - `data-valid`: In a field: present once the number was checked and found right.
    - `data-invalid`: In a field: present while the number is wrong.
- input: The text input: it takes what its locale writes a number with.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-readonly`: Present when the number cannot be changed.
    - `data-required`: Present when a number must be given.
    - `data-touched`: Present once focus has left the input.
    - `data-dirty`: Present while the number is not the one it started with.
    - `data-filled`: Present while there is a number.
    - `data-focused`: Present while the input has focus.
    - `data-scrubbing`: Present while the number is dragged from its scrub area.
    - `data-valid`: In a field: present once the number was checked and found right.
    - `data-invalid`: In a field: present while the number is wrong.
- increment: A button that steps the number up. Held, it goes on.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-readonly`: Present when the number cannot be changed.
    - `data-required`: Present when a number must be given.
    - `data-touched`: Present once focus has left the input.
    - `data-dirty`: Present while the number is not the one it started with.
    - `data-filled`: Present while there is a number.
    - `data-focused`: Present while the input has focus.
    - `data-scrubbing`: Present while the number is dragged from its scrub area.
    - `data-valid`: In a field: present once the number was checked and found right.
    - `data-invalid`: In a field: present while the number is wrong.
- decrement: A button that steps the number down. Held, it goes on.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-readonly`: Present when the number cannot be changed.
    - `data-required`: Present when a number must be given.
    - `data-touched`: Present once focus has left the input.
    - `data-dirty`: Present while the number is not the one it started with.
    - `data-filled`: Present while there is a number.
    - `data-focused`: Present while the input has focus.
    - `data-scrubbing`: Present while the number is dragged from its scrub area.
    - `data-valid`: In a field: present once the number was checked and found right.
    - `data-invalid`: In a field: present while the number is wrong.
- scrubArea: An area that is pressed and dragged to change the number: the field's label, as a rule. It takes `direction`, `pixelSensitivity` and `teleportDistance`. A mouse's pointer is locked for the drag where the browser has that (not in Safari); a finger drags as it is.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-readonly`: Present when the number cannot be changed.
    - `data-required`: Present when a number must be given.
    - `data-touched`: Present once focus has left the input.
    - `data-dirty`: Present while the number is not the one it started with.
    - `data-filled`: Present while there is a number.
    - `data-focused`: Present while the input has focus.
    - `data-scrubbing`: Present while the number is dragged from its scrub area.
    - `data-valid`: In a field: present once the number was checked and found right.
    - `data-invalid`: In a field: present while the number is wrong.
- scrubAreaCursor: What is drawn in place of the pointer while it is locked for a drag: in the page only then, at the end of `<body>`, placed by the component.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-readonly`: Present when the number cannot be changed.
    - `data-required`: Present when a number must be given.
    - `data-touched`: Present once focus has left the input.
    - `data-dirty`: Present while the number is not the one it started with.
    - `data-filled`: Present while there is a number.
    - `data-focused`: Present while the input has focus.
    - `data-scrubbing`: Present while the number is dragged from its scrub area.
    - `data-valid`: In a field: present once the number was checked and found right.
    - `data-invalid`: In a field: present while the number is wrong.

### Otp

```
import { KuiOtp, KuiOtpInput, KuiOtpGroup, KuiOtpSlot, KuiOtpSeparator, KuiOtpCaret } from "@kirana-ui/angular"
```

Parts: `[kuiOtp]`, `input[kuiOtpInput]`, `[kuiOtpGroup]`, `[kuiOtpSlot]`, `[kuiOtpSeparator]`, `[kuiOtpCaret]`.

Anatomy:

```
kuiOtp
  input[kuiOtpInput]
  kuiOtpGroup (repeated)
    kuiOtpSlot (repeated)
      *kuiOtpCaret
  kuiOtpSeparator (repeated)
```

Props of its root:

- `length?: number`: How many characters the code has. Default: 6.
- `[(value)]: string`: The characters typed so far, when the caller holds them.
- `defaultValue?: string`: The characters it starts with, when the caller does not hold `value`. Read once. Default `""`.
- `mode?: "numeric" | "alphabetic" | "alphanumeric" | "text"`: What a character may be: a digit (`numeric`), a letter (`alphabetic`, `a` to `z` either case), either (`alphanumeric`), or anything but white space (`text`). It also says which keyboard a phone shows: the digits' for `numeric`, letters' otherwise. Default: `numeric`, on purpose: a one-time code is digits, and its keyboard is then the one to type them on.
- `pattern?: string`: What else a character may be: a regular expression, as text, that one character must match whole (`"[A-F0-9]"`), in place of `mode`'s rule. Text, as an attribute can only be, so it is given the same way on every framework and on a custom element. With a pattern, `mode` only says the keyboard, and defaults to `text`.
- `disabled?: boolean`: Disabled: it cannot be changed.
- `name?: string`: With a name, the code is submitted with the form around it.
- `form?: string`: The id of the form the input belongs to, when it is not inside it.
- `(valueChanged): { value: string; details: ChangeDetails }`: Heard as the characters are about to change: `details.cancel()` keeps them as they were.
- `(completed): string`: Every character is in: the moment to send the code.

Each part, and its own props:

- `[kuiOtp]` is `KuiOtp`. `exportAs: "kuiOtp"`. Its props are above.
- `input[kuiOtpInput]` is `KuiOtpInput`. `<input kuiOtpInput>`: the one input the code is typed in.
- `[kuiOtpGroup]` is `KuiOtpGroup`. Cells that are drawn together.
- `[kuiOtpSlot]` is `KuiOtpSlot`. One cell. It writes its character before whatever is inside it (a caret), and leaves that alone.
    - `index: number`: Required. Which character of the code it shows, from 0.
- `[kuiOtpSeparator]` is `KuiOtpSeparator`. A mark between groups of cells.
- `[kuiOtpCaret]` is `KuiOtpCaret`. Structural: written `*kuiOtpCaret`. `<div *kuiOtpCaret>`: in its cell while the cell is the active one and empty.

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- root: The code: the input and its cells.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-focused`: Present while the input has focus.
    - `data-complete`: Present when every character is in.
- input: The one input the code is typed in. A design lays it over the cells, unseen.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- slot: One cell of the code.
    - `data-index`: The cell's place, from 0.
    - `data-active`: Present on the cell the next character goes in, or that is selected.
    - `data-filled`: Present when the cell has its character.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.

### Pagination

```
import { KuiPagination, KuiPaginationItems, KuiPaginationItem, KuiPaginationEllipsis, KuiPaginationPrevious, KuiPaginationNext } from "@kirana-ui/angular"
```

Parts: `[kuiPagination]`, `[kuiPaginationItems]`, `[kuiPaginationItem]`, `[kuiPaginationEllipsis]`, `[kuiPaginationPrevious]`, `[kuiPaginationNext]`.

Anatomy:

```
kuiPagination
  *kuiPaginationItems
    kuiPaginationItem (repeated)
    kuiPaginationEllipsis (repeated)
  kuiPaginationPrevious
  kuiPaginationNext
```

Props of its root:

- `[(page)]: number`: The page shown, from 1.
- `defaultPage?: number`: The page it starts at, when the caller does not hold `page`. Read once. Default `1`.
- `count: number`: Required. How many items there are in all.
- `pageSize?: number`: How many items a page holds. Default 10.
- `siblingCount?: number`: How many pages are listed each side of the one shown. Default 1.
- `boundaryCount?: number`: How many pages are always listed at each end. Default 1.
- `disabled?: boolean`: Disabled: no page can be gone to.
- `(pageChanged): { page: number; details: ChangeDetails }`: Heard as another page is about to be shown: `details.cancel()` keeps the page as it was.

Each part, and its own props:

- `[kuiPagination]` is `KuiPagination`. `exportAs: "kuiPagination"`. On a `<nav>`. `[(page)]` is the page shown, from 1. Its props are above.
- `[kuiPaginationItems]` is `KuiPaginationItems`. Structural: written `*kuiPaginationItems`. Its template is given the entry: `let entry` is a `PaginationEntry`. `<ng-container *kuiPaginationItems="let entry">`: once for each piece of the row, a page or the mark for pages left out.
- `[kuiPaginationItem]` is `KuiPaginationItem`.
    - `page: number`: Required. The page it goes to, from 1.
- `[kuiPaginationEllipsis]` is `KuiPaginationEllipsis`. The mark for pages left out of the row.
- `[kuiPaginationPrevious]` is `KuiPaginationPrevious`.
- `[kuiPaginationNext]` is `KuiPaginationNext`.

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- root: The pages of a list, as a navigation.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- item: A page: pressed, it is the one shown.
    - `data-selected`: Present on the page that is shown.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- previous: Goes to the page before.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- next: Goes to the page after.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.

### Popover

```
import { KuiPopover, KuiPopoverTrigger, KuiPopoverPortal, KuiPopoverBackdrop, KuiPopoverPositioner, KuiPopoverPopup, KuiPopoverArrow, KuiPopoverTitle, KuiPopoverDescription, KuiPopoverClose } from "@kirana-ui/angular"
```

Parts: `[kuiPopover]`, `[kuiPopoverTrigger]`, `[kuiPopoverPortal]`, `[kuiPopoverBackdrop]`, `[kuiPopoverPositioner]`, `[kuiPopoverPopup]`, `[kuiPopoverArrow]`, `[kuiPopoverTitle]`, `[kuiPopoverDescription]`, `[kuiPopoverClose]`.

Anatomy:

```
kuiPopover
  kuiPopoverTrigger
  *kuiPopoverPortal
    kuiPopoverBackdrop
    kuiPopoverPositioner
      kuiPopoverPopup
        kuiPopoverTitle
        kuiPopoverDescription
        kuiPopoverClose
        kuiPopoverArrow
```

Props of its root:

- `[(open)]: boolean`: Whether it is open, when the caller holds it.
- `defaultOpen?: boolean`: Whether it starts open, when the caller does not hold `open`. Read once.
- `modal?: boolean | "trap-focus"`: What the page behind it may do while it is open. `false` (the default): everything. `true`: nothing, the page is inert and does not scroll, and Tab stays inside the popover. `"trap-focus"`: Tab stays inside the popover, and the page can still be pressed and scrolled. A popover the pointer opened holds nothing until it is pressed. Read as it opens.
- `(openChanged): { open: boolean; details: ChangeDetails }`: Heard as it is about to open or close: `details.cancel()` keeps it as it was.

Each part, and its own props:

- `[kuiPopover]` is `KuiPopover`. `exportAs: "kuiPopover"`. Holds the popover: whether it is open. Its props are above.
- `[kuiPopoverTrigger]` is `KuiPopoverTrigger`.
    - `openOnHover?: boolean`: Whether the pointer resting on the trigger opens the popover too. A press and the keyboard still open it, and a press on one the pointer opened keeps it open. Default `false`.
    - `delay?: number`: How long the pointer rests on the trigger before the popover opens, in milliseconds. Default 300.
    - `closeDelay?: number`: How long after the pointer leaves a popover it opened closes, in milliseconds. Default 0.
- `[kuiPopoverPortal]` is `KuiPopoverPortal`. Structural: written `*kuiPopoverPortal`. Draws what it holds at the end of `<body>`, or in the container a `PortalProvider` names.
- `[kuiPopoverBackdrop]` is `KuiPopoverBackdrop`.
- `[kuiPopoverPositioner]` is `KuiPopoverPositioner`. Takes the positioner options ("Positioner options", above).
- `[kuiPopoverPopup]` is `KuiPopoverPopup`.
- `[kuiPopoverArrow]` is `KuiPopoverArrow`.
- `[kuiPopoverTitle]` is `KuiPopoverTitle`. The heading that names the popover.
- `[kuiPopoverDescription]` is `KuiPopoverDescription`. The text that describes the popover.
- `[kuiPopoverClose]` is `KuiPopoverClose`. A button that closes the popover.

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- trigger: The button that opens the popover, and what it is placed against.
    - `data-popup-open`: Present when the popover is open.
- backdrop: A layer over the page behind the popover.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-starting-style`: Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from.
    - `data-ending-style`: Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends.
- positioner: Places the popup against the trigger. It carries the geometry.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-side="top | right | bottom | left | inline-start | inline-end"`: The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip. Asked for as `inline-start` or `inline-end`, it says one of those two when it is beside its anchor.
    - `data-align="start | center | end"`: How it is aligned with the anchor.
    - `--anchor-width`: The anchor's width.
    - `--anchor-height`: The anchor's height.
    - `--available-width`: The width between the anchor and the edge of the viewport.
    - `--available-height`: The height between the anchor and the edge of the viewport.
    - `--transform-origin`: The point of the popup nearest its anchor, to scale from.
- popup: The popover itself.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-starting-style`: Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from.
    - `data-ending-style`: Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends.
    - `data-side="top | right | bottom | left | inline-start | inline-end"`: The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip. Asked for as `inline-start` or `inline-end`, it says one of those two when it is beside its anchor.
    - `data-align="start | center | end"`: How it is aligned with the anchor.
- arrow: An element that points at the trigger, placed along the popup's edge.
    - `data-side="top | right | bottom | left | inline-start | inline-end"`: The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip. Asked for as `inline-start` or `inline-end`, it says one of those two when it is beside its anchor.
    - `data-align="start | center | end"`: How it is aligned with the anchor.
    - `data-uncentered`: Present when the popup was pushed along its edge, so the arrow is not at the trigger's centre.

### Progress

```
import { KuiProgress, KuiProgressTrack, KuiProgressIndicator, KuiProgressValue, KuiProgressLabel } from "@kirana-ui/angular"
```

Parts: `[kuiProgress]`, `[kuiProgressTrack]`, `[kuiProgressIndicator]`, `[kuiProgressValue]`, `[kuiProgressLabel]`.

Anatomy:

```
kuiProgress
  kuiProgressTrack
    kuiProgressIndicator
  kuiProgressValue
  kuiProgressLabel
```

Props of its root:

- `value: number | null`: Required. The value. For a progress bar, `null` is "under way, how far is not known".
- `min?: number`: Default 0.
- `max?: number`: Default 100.
- `format?: Intl.NumberFormatOptions`: How the value is written; a percentage of the range by default.
- `locale?: string`: The language the value is written in; the page's by default.
- `getAriaValueText?: (text: string | undefined, value: number | null) => string`: What assistive technology reads for the value, when the written value is not enough.

Each part, and its own props:

- `[kuiProgress]` is `KuiProgress`. `exportAs: "kuiProgress"`. Its props are above.
- `[kuiProgressTrack]` is `KuiProgressTrack`.
- `[kuiProgressIndicator]` is `KuiProgressIndicator`.
- `[kuiProgressValue]` is `KuiProgressValue`. Shows the written value.
- `[kuiProgressLabel]` is `KuiProgressLabel`.

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- root: The progress bar: it says the value to assistive technology.
    - `data-progressing`: Present while the task is under way.
    - `data-complete`: Present once the value has reached the end of the range.
    - `data-indeterminate`: Present while how far the task has come is not known.
- track: The whole range.
    - `data-progressing`: Present while the task is under way.
    - `data-complete`: Present once the value has reached the end of the range.
    - `data-indeterminate`: Present while how far the task has come is not known.
- indicator: The filled part: its width is the value's share of the range.
    - `data-progressing`: Present while the task is under way.
    - `data-complete`: Present once the value has reached the end of the range.
    - `data-indeterminate`: Present while how far the task has come is not known.
- value: The value, written.
    - `data-progressing`: Present while the task is under way.
    - `data-complete`: Present once the value has reached the end of the range.
    - `data-indeterminate`: Present while how far the task has come is not known.
- label: The bar's name.
    - `data-progressing`: Present while the task is under way.
    - `data-complete`: Present once the value has reached the end of the range.
    - `data-indeterminate`: Present while how far the task has come is not known.

### QrCode

```
import { KuiQrCode, KuiQrCodeFrame, KuiQrCodePattern } from "@kirana-ui/angular"
```

Parts: `[kuiQrCode]`, `[kuiQrCodeFrame]`, `[kuiQrCodePattern]`.

Anatomy:

```
kuiQrCode
  kuiQrCodeFrame
    kuiQrCodePattern
```

Props of its root:

- `value?: string`: What the code says: a link, a text.
- `correction?: QrCorrection`: How much of it may be lost and still be read. Default: `"M"`.

Each part, and its own props:

- `[kuiQrCode]` is `KuiQrCode`. `exportAs: "kuiQrCode"`. Its props are above.
- `[kuiQrCodeFrame]` is `KuiQrCodeFrame`. `<svg kuiQrCodeFrame>`: the drawing.
- `[kuiQrCodePattern]` is `KuiQrCodePattern`. `<svg:path kuiQrCodePattern>`: the dark modules.

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- root: What holds the code.
    - `data-invalid`: Present when the value is longer than a code holds.

### RadioGroup

```
import { KuiRadioGroup, KuiRadioGroupItem, KuiRadioGroupIndicator } from "@kirana-ui/angular"
```

Parts: `[kuiRadioGroup]`, `[kuiRadioGroupItem]`, `[kuiRadioGroupIndicator]`.

Anatomy:

```
kuiRadioGroup
  kuiRadioGroupItem (repeated)
    *kuiRadioGroupIndicator
```

Props of its root:

- `[(value)]: Value | null`: The chosen value; `null` is "none".
- `defaultValue?: NoInfer<Value> | null`: The value it starts with, when the caller does not hold `value`. Read once.
- `disabled?: boolean`: Disables every item of the group.
- `readOnly?: boolean`: Shown as it is, focusable, not changeable.
- `required?: boolean`: Needed: in a `Field`, choosing none is then invalid.
- `name?: string`: With a name, the chosen value is submitted with the form around the group.
- `form?: string`: The id of the form the control belongs to, when it is not inside it.
- `(valueChanged): { value: Value | null; details: ChangeDetails }`: The change with why it happened; `details.cancel()` keeps the value.

Each part, and its own props:

- `[kuiRadioGroup]` is `KuiRadioGroup`. `exportAs: "kuiRadioGroup"`. Generic: `<Value = unknown>`. Its props are above.
- `[kuiRadioGroupItem]` is `KuiRadioGroupItem`. On an item's element. It draws the hidden native radio inside it, which a form and a label reach.
    - `value: unknown`: Required. What the group's value is while this item is the chosen one.
    - `disabled?: boolean`: Disables this item: it cannot be chosen.
- `[kuiRadioGroupIndicator]` is `KuiRadioGroupIndicator`. Structural: written `*kuiRadioGroupIndicator`. `<span *kuiRadioGroupIndicator>`: in the page while its item is the chosen one.

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- root: Groups the items: one of them is chosen at most.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-readonly`: Present when it can be read but not changed.
    - `data-required`: Present when the form needs it.
- item: One choice. It holds a hidden native radio, which a form and a label reach: the item's `id` (`kuiId` on Angular, `kui-id` on a custom element) is the radio's, which a `<label for>` names.
    - `data-checked`: Present when it is checked.
    - `data-unchecked`: Present when it is not checked.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-readonly`: Present when it can be read but not changed.
    - `data-required`: Present when the form needs it.
- indicator: The mark. In the page while its item is the chosen one.
    - `data-checked`: Present when it is checked.
    - `data-unchecked`: Present when it is not checked.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-readonly`: Present when it can be read but not changed.
    - `data-required`: Present when the form needs it.
    - `data-starting-style`: Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from.
    - `data-ending-style`: Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends.

### Resizable

```
import { KuiResizableGroup, KuiResizablePanel, KuiResizableHandle } from "@kirana-ui/angular"
```

Parts: `[kuiResizableGroup]`, `[kuiResizablePanel]`, `[kuiResizableHandle]`.

Anatomy:

```
kuiResizableGroup
  kuiResizablePanel (repeated)
  kuiResizableHandle (repeated)
```

Props of its root:

- `orientation?: Orientation`: Whether the panels are side by side (the default) or one over the other.
- `keyboardStep?: number`: How far an arrow key moves a handle, in hundredths of the group. Default: 10.
- `disabled?: boolean`: Disabled: the handles cannot be dragged or moved with the keyboard.
- `(sizesChanged): { sizes: number[]; details: ChangeDetails }`: Each panel's share as the panels are resized, with why.

Each part, and its own props:

- `[kuiResizableGroup]` is `KuiResizableGroup`. `exportAs: "kuiResizableGroup"`. Its props are above.
- `[kuiResizablePanel]` is `KuiResizablePanel`.
    - `defaultSize?: number`: Its share to begin with, in hundredths of the group. Either every panel gives one or none does (they are then equal).
    - `minSize?: number`: The least it can be made. Default: 0.
    - `maxSize?: number`: The most it can be made. Default: 100.
- `[kuiResizableHandle]` is `KuiResizableHandle`.
    - `disabled?: boolean`: Disables this handle: it cannot be dragged or moved with the keyboard.

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- group: The panels and the bars between them. A design lays it out as a flex box: `display: flex`, and `flex-direction: column` when it is vertical. A group in a panel that is a flex box itself takes `min-width: 0` and `min-height: 0`, or what it holds widens the panel.
    - `data-orientation="horizontal | vertical"`: Whether the panels are side by side or one over the other.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- panel: One panel. It carries its share of the group, written as its `flex` with `min-width: 0` and `min-height: 0`, so what it holds cannot keep it past its share. Its `overflow` is the design's.
    - `data-orientation="horizontal | vertical"`: Whether the panels are side by side or one over the other.
    - `--panel-size`: The panel's share, in hundredths of the group.
- handle: The bar between two panels: dragged, or moved with the arrows. A design gives it its thickness and `flex-shrink: 0`, so the panels do not squeeze it.
    - `data-orientation="horizontal | vertical"`: Whether the panels are side by side or one over the other.
    - `data-dragging`: Present while the bar is dragged.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.

### ScrollArea

```
import { KuiScrollArea, KuiScrollAreaViewport, KuiScrollAreaContent, KuiScrollAreaScrollbar, KuiScrollAreaThumb, KuiScrollAreaCorner } from "@kirana-ui/angular"
```

Parts: `[kuiScrollArea]`, `[kuiScrollAreaViewport]`, `[kuiScrollAreaContent]`, `[kuiScrollAreaScrollbar]`, `[kuiScrollAreaThumb]`, `[kuiScrollAreaCorner]`.

Anatomy:

```
kuiScrollArea
  kuiScrollAreaViewport
    kuiScrollAreaContent (optional)
    *kuiScrollAreaScrollbar (repeated, as above)
  *kuiScrollAreaScrollbar (repeated)
    kuiScrollAreaThumb
  *kuiScrollAreaCorner
```

Each part, and its own props:

- `[kuiScrollArea]` is `KuiScrollArea`. `exportAs: "kuiScrollArea"`.
- `[kuiScrollAreaViewport]` is `KuiScrollAreaViewport`.
- `[kuiScrollAreaContent]` is `KuiScrollAreaContent`. A box around what is scrolled, as wide as what it holds. Not needed to measure: the viewport's children are watched as they are. For content whose own box does not grow with what is in it (a block holding a wider table, or bare text).
- `[kuiScrollAreaScrollbar]` is `KuiScrollAreaScrollbar`. Structural: written `*kuiScrollAreaScrollbar`. `<div *kuiScrollAreaScrollbar="'horizontal'">`: in the page while there is something to scroll its way (`vertical` when no orientation is given).
    - `*kuiScrollAreaScrollbar: Orientation | ""`: The directive's own value: `*kuiScrollAreaScrollbar="…"`. Which way it scrolls: `'horizontal'`, or `'vertical'` when none is given.
    - `keepMounted?: boolean`: Written after the directive's value: `*kuiScrollAreaScrollbar="…; keepMounted: …"`. In the page even while there is nothing to scroll its way.
- `[kuiScrollAreaThumb]` is `KuiScrollAreaThumb`.
- `[kuiScrollAreaCorner]` is `KuiScrollAreaCorner`. Structural: written `*kuiScrollAreaCorner`. `<div *kuiScrollAreaCorner>`: in the page while both scrollbars are.

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- root: The area. It holds the viewport and the scrollbars, which the library places against it: a design gives a scrollbar its thickness and draws it, and places nothing.
    - `data-has-overflow-x`: Present when there is more to see sideways.
    - `data-has-overflow-y`: Present when there is more to see up or down.
    - `data-scrolling`: Present while it is being scrolled, and a moment after.
    - `data-hovering`: Present while the pointer is over the area.
    - `--scroll-area-corner-width`: The width of the corner: the vertical scrollbar's, while both scrollbars and the corner are in the page.
    - `--scroll-area-corner-height`: The height of the corner: the horizontal scrollbar's, while both scrollbars and the corner are in the page.
- viewport: The element that scrolls.
    - `data-has-overflow-x`: Present when there is more to see sideways.
    - `data-has-overflow-y`: Present when there is more to see up or down.
    - `data-scrolling`: Present while it is being scrolled, and a moment after.
- scrollbar: A scrollbar's track, placed along its edge of the area. In the page while there is something to scroll its way.
    - `data-orientation="horizontal | vertical"`: Which way the scrollbar scrolls.
    - `data-hovering`: Present while the pointer is over the area.
    - `data-scrolling`: Present while the area is scrolled its way.
    - `--scroll-area-thumb-height`: A vertical thumb's height.
    - `--scroll-area-thumb-width`: A horizontal thumb's width.
- thumb: The part of a scrollbar that shows where the view is, and can be dragged. As long as its scrollbar's variable says.
    - `data-orientation="horizontal | vertical"`: Which way the scrollbar scrolls.

### Select

```
import { KuiSelect, KuiSelectTrigger, KuiSelectValue, KuiSelectPortal, KuiSelectPositioner, KuiSelectPopup, KuiSelectList, KuiSelectScrollUpArrow, KuiSelectScrollDownArrow, KuiSelectGroup, KuiSelectGroupLabel, KuiSelectSeparator, KuiSelectItem, KuiSelectItemText, KuiSelectItemIndicator, KuiSelectInput } from "@kirana-ui/angular"
```

Parts: `[kuiSelect]`, `[kuiSelectTrigger]`, `[kuiSelectValue]`, `[kuiSelectPortal]`, `[kuiSelectPositioner]`, `[kuiSelectPopup]`, `[kuiSelectList]`, `[kuiSelectScrollUpArrow]`, `[kuiSelectScrollDownArrow]`, `[kuiSelectGroup]`, `[kuiSelectGroupLabel]`, `[kuiSelectSeparator]`, `[kuiSelectItem]`, `[kuiSelectItemText]`, `[kuiSelectItemIndicator]`.

Anatomy:

```
kuiSelect
  kuiSelectTrigger
    *kuiSelectValue
  *kuiSelectPortal
    kuiSelectPositioner
      kuiSelectPopup
        *kuiSelectScrollUpArrow
        kuiSelectList (optional)
          kuiSelectGroup (optional, repeated)
            kuiSelectGroupLabel
            kuiSelectItem (repeated)
              kuiSelectItemText
              *kuiSelectItemIndicator
          kuiSelectSeparator (repeated)
        *kuiSelectScrollDownArrow
  input[kuiSelectInput] (Angular only)
```

Props of its root:

- `[(value)]: Value | null`: The chosen value; `null` is "none".
- `defaultValue?: NoInfer<Value> | null`: The value it starts with, when the caller does not hold `value`. Read once.
- `[(open)]: boolean`: Whether the list is open, when the caller holds it.
- `defaultOpen?: boolean`: Whether the list starts open, when the caller does not hold `open`. Read once.
- `disabled?: boolean`: Disabled: it cannot be changed.
- `readOnly?: boolean`: Shown as it is, focusable, not changeable: the list still opens, and nothing is chosen.
- `required?: boolean`: In a field, "none" is then wrong.
- `name?: string`: With a name, the value is submitted with the form around it.
- `form?: string`: The id of the form the control belongs to, when it is not inside it.
- `items?: ItemLabels<Value>`: The values' labels: a list of values with their labels, or the labels by value.
- `multiple?: boolean`: Several values: they are `values`, not `value`.
- `[(values)]: readonly Value[]`: With `multiple`: the chosen values, in the order they were chosen.
- `defaultValues?: readonly Value[]`: With `multiple`: the values it starts with, when the caller does not hold `values`. Read once.
- `(valuesChanged): { values: Value[]; details: ChangeDetails }`: With `multiple`: heard as a value is about to be added or taken away, with the values there would then be: `details.cancel()` keeps them as they were.
- `virtualized?: ListCollection`: Every row, when only some are in the page: each item is then given its `index`.
- `(valueChanged): { value: Value | null; details: ChangeDetails }`: Heard as a value is about to be chosen: `details.cancel()` keeps it as it was.
- `(openChanged): { open: boolean; details: ChangeDetails }`: Heard as the list is about to open or close: `details.cancel()` keeps it as it was.

Each part, and its own props:

- `[kuiSelect]` is `KuiSelect`. `exportAs: "kuiSelect"`. Generic: `<Value = unknown>`. Holds the select: its value and whether the list is open. Its props are above.
- `[kuiSelectTrigger]` is `KuiSelectTrigger`.
- `[kuiSelectValue]` is `KuiSelectValue`. Structural: written `*kuiSelectValue`. Its template is given the entry: `let entry` is a `SelectShown`. `<span kuiSelectValue>` shows the chosen value's label, or `placeholder` while nothing is chosen; with `multiple`, the chosen labels with commas between. `<span *kuiSelectValue="let shown">` draws its own content instead, with what is chosen: `shown.value` and `shown.label`, with `multiple` `shown.values` and `shown.labels`, in the items' order.
    - `placeholder?: string`: Shown while nothing is chosen.
- `[kuiSelectPortal]` is `KuiSelectPortal`. Structural: written `*kuiSelectPortal`. Draws what it holds at the end of `<body>`, or in the container a `PortalProvider` names.
- `[kuiSelectPositioner]` is `KuiSelectPositioner`. Takes the positioner options ("Positioner options", above).
    - `alignItemWithTrigger?: boolean`: The list opens over its trigger, the chosen item's text on the trigger's own, where there is room and unless a finger opened it.
- `[kuiSelectPopup]` is `KuiSelectPopup`.
- `[kuiSelectList]` is `KuiSelectList`. The items' own box inside the popup, when the popup also holds scroll arrows.
- `[kuiSelectScrollUpArrow]` is `KuiSelectScrollUpArrow`. Structural: written `*kuiSelectScrollUpArrow`. `<div *kuiSelectScrollUpArrow>`: in the page while there is more of the list above. It scrolls the list while the pointer moves over it.
- `[kuiSelectScrollDownArrow]` is `KuiSelectScrollDownArrow`. Structural: written `*kuiSelectScrollDownArrow`. `<div *kuiSelectScrollDownArrow>`: in the page while there is more of the list below.
- `[kuiSelectGroup]` is `KuiSelectGroup`. Items that belong together, named by their `kuiSelectGroupLabel`.
- `[kuiSelectGroupLabel]` is `KuiSelectGroupLabel`. Names the group it is in. With no group around it, it is plain text.
- `[kuiSelectSeparator]` is `KuiSelectSeparator`. A line between groups.
- `[kuiSelectItem]` is `KuiSelectItem`.
    - `value: unknown`: Required. What the select's value is while this item is chosen.
    - `disabled?: boolean`: Disables this item: it cannot be chosen, and the arrows pass over it.
    - `label?: string`: What typeahead matches and the trigger shows; the item's text when left out.
    - `index?: number`: Its place among all the rows, in a virtualized list.
- `[kuiSelectItemText]` is `KuiSelectItemText`. The item's name: what the trigger shows once it is chosen.
- `[kuiSelectItemIndicator]` is `KuiSelectItemIndicator`. Structural: written `*kuiSelectItemIndicator`. `<span *kuiSelectItemIndicator>`: in the page while its item is the chosen one.
- `input[kuiSelectInput]` is `KuiSelectInput`. `<input kuiSelectInput>`: submits the value with the form around it. Angular only.

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- trigger: The button that shows the value and opens the list.
    - `data-popup-open`: Present when the list is open.
    - `data-placeholder`: Present while nothing is chosen.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-readonly`: Present when it can be read but not changed.
- value: The chosen value's label, or the placeholder. With several values, their labels with commas between.
    - `data-placeholder`: Present while nothing is chosen.
- positioner: Places the list against the trigger. It carries the geometry.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-side="top | right | bottom | left | inline-start | inline-end | none"`: The side of the trigger it is on, after any flip; `none` when it lies over the trigger.
    - `data-align="start | center | end"`: How it is aligned with the anchor.
    - `--anchor-width`: The anchor's width.
    - `--anchor-height`: The anchor's height.
    - `--available-width`: The width between the anchor and the edge of the viewport.
    - `--available-height`: The height between the anchor and the edge of the viewport.
    - `--transform-origin`: The point of the popup nearest its anchor, to scale from.
- scrollUpArrow: In the page while there is more of the list above: it scrolls the list while the pointer moves over it.
    - `data-direction="up | down"`: The way it scrolls the list.
    - `data-visible`: Present while there is more of the list its way.
    - `data-side="top | right | bottom | left | inline-start | inline-end | none"`: The side of the trigger the list is on; `none` when it lies over the trigger.
    - `data-starting-style`: Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from.
    - `data-ending-style`: Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends.
- scrollDownArrow: In the page while there is more of the list below: it scrolls the list while the pointer moves over it.
    - `data-direction="up | down"`: The way it scrolls the list.
    - `data-visible`: Present while there is more of the list its way.
    - `data-side="top | right | bottom | left | inline-start | inline-end | none"`: The side of the trigger the list is on; `none` when it lies over the trigger.
    - `data-starting-style`: Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from.
    - `data-ending-style`: Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends.
- popup: The list of items.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-starting-style`: Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from.
    - `data-ending-style`: Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends.
    - `data-side="top | right | bottom | left | inline-start | inline-end"`: The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip. Asked for as `inline-start` or `inline-end`, it says one of those two when it is beside its anchor.
    - `data-align="start | center | end"`: How it is aligned with the anchor.
- item: One choice in the list.
    - `data-selected`: Present on the chosen item, or on each of several.
    - `data-highlighted`: Present on the item the pointer or the keyboard is on.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.

### Separator

```
import { KuiSeparator } from "@kirana-ui/angular"
```

Props:

- `orientation?: Orientation`: Whether the line lies across (the default) or stands upright: what a screen reader is told.

`[kuiSeparator]` is `KuiSeparator`. `exportAs: "kuiSeparator"`.

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- root: The line.
    - `data-orientation="horizontal | vertical"`: The way the line runs.

### Slider

```
import { KuiSlider, KuiSliderValue, KuiSliderControl, KuiSliderTrack, KuiSliderIndicator, KuiSliderThumb } from "@kirana-ui/angular"
```

Parts: `[kuiSlider]`, `[kuiSliderValue]`, `[kuiSliderControl]`, `[kuiSliderTrack]`, `[kuiSliderIndicator]`, `[kuiSliderThumb]`.

Anatomy:

```
kuiSlider
  kuiSliderValue
  kuiSliderControl
    kuiSliderTrack
      kuiSliderIndicator
      kuiSliderThumb (repeated)
```

Props of its root:

- `[(value)]: Value`: A number for one thumb, a list for a range: what is told back is the same kind.
- `defaultValue?: NoInfer<Value>`: Read once. Default `min`.
- `min?: number`: Default 0.
- `max?: number`: Default 100.
- `step?: number`: Default 1.
- `largeStep?: number`: What Page Up, Page Down and an arrow with Shift move by. Default 10.
- `minStepsBetweenValues?: number`: How many steps two thumbs of a range stay apart. Default 0.
- `thumbAlignment?: "center" | "edge" | "edge-client-only"`: `"edge"` keeps a thumb inside the control at the ends of its range. Default `"center"`.
- `orientation?: "horizontal" | "vertical"`: Whether the track lies across (the default) or stands upright: the arrows that move a thumb follow.
- `disabled?: boolean`: Disabled: it cannot be changed.
- `readOnly?: boolean`: Shown as it is, focusable, not changeable; its value is still submitted.
- `name?: string`: With a name, each thumb's value is submitted with the form around the slider.
- `form?: string`: The id of the form the control belongs to, when it is not inside it.
- `format?: Intl.NumberFormatOptions`: How a value is written.
- `locale?: string`: The language a value is written in; the page's by default.
- `getAriaValueText?: (text: string, value: number, index: number) => string`: What assistive technology reads for a thumb, when the written value is not enough.
- `(valueChanged): { value: SliderTold<Value>; details: SliderChangeDetails }`: Each step of a drag and each key, with why; `details.cancel()` keeps the value.
- `(valueCommitted): { value: SliderTold<Value>; details: SliderChangeDetails }`: When the pointer lets go, and after each key.

Each part, and its own props:

- `[kuiSlider]` is `KuiSlider`. `exportAs: "kuiSlider"`. Generic: `<Value extends SliderValue = SliderValue>`. Its props are above.
- `[kuiSliderValue]` is `KuiSliderValue`. Shows the written value.
- `[kuiSliderControl]` is `KuiSliderControl`.
- `[kuiSliderTrack]` is `KuiSliderTrack`.
- `[kuiSliderIndicator]` is `KuiSliderIndicator`.
- `[kuiSliderThumb]` is `KuiSliderThumb`. On a thumb's element. It draws the hidden input inside it, which a form reads.
    - `index?: number`: Which value of a range the thumb is, from 0. A thumb that is given none takes its place among the slider's thumbs, in the order they are written.

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- root: Groups the slider's parts.
    - `data-orientation="horizontal | vertical"`: The way the track runs.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-readonly`: Present when it can be read but not changed.
    - `data-dragging`: Present while a pointer holds a thumb.
- value: The value, written.
    - `data-orientation="horizontal | vertical"`: The way the track runs.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-readonly`: Present when it can be read but not changed.
    - `data-dragging`: Present while a pointer holds a thumb.
- control: What a pointer presses and drags on. It holds the track and the thumbs.
    - `data-orientation="horizontal | vertical"`: The way the track runs.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-readonly`: Present when it can be read but not changed.
    - `data-dragging`: Present while a pointer holds a thumb.
- track: The whole range.
    - `data-orientation="horizontal | vertical"`: The way the track runs.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-readonly`: Present when it can be read but not changed.
    - `data-dragging`: Present while a pointer holds a thumb.
- indicator: The filled part: up to the thumb, or from the first thumb to the last. Its place and length are written on it.
    - `data-orientation="horizontal | vertical"`: The way the track runs.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-readonly`: Present when it can be read but not changed.
    - `data-dragging`: Present while a pointer holds a thumb.
    - `--start-position`: With thumbs that stay inside the control: where the filled part starts, or with one thumb where it ends.
    - `--relative-size`: With thumbs that stay inside the control and a range: the filled part's length.
- thumb: What is dragged, and what the keyboard moves: a slider to assistive technology. Its place on the track is written on it. It holds a hidden input, which a form reads. A thumb that is given no `index` is the value at its place among the slider's thumbs, in the order they are written.
    - `data-orientation="horizontal | vertical"`: The way the track runs.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-readonly`: Present when it can be read but not changed.
    - `data-dragging`: Present while a pointer holds a thumb.
    - `data-index`: Which thumb it is, from 0.
    - `--position`: With thumbs that stay inside the control: where the thumb's centre is.

### Switch

```
import { KuiSwitch, KuiSwitchThumb } from "@kirana-ui/angular"
```

Parts: `[kuiSwitch]`, `[kuiSwitchThumb]`.

Anatomy:

```
kuiSwitch
  kuiSwitchThumb
```

Props of its root:

- `[(checked)]: boolean`: Whether it is checked, when the caller holds it.
- `defaultChecked?: boolean`: Read once.
- `disabled?: boolean`: Disabled: it cannot be changed.
- `readOnly?: boolean`: Shown as it is, focusable, not changeable.
- `required?: boolean`: Needed: in a `Field`, leaving it unchecked is then invalid.
- `name?: string`: With a name, the control is submitted with the form around it when it is checked.
- `form?: string`: The id of the form the control belongs to, when it is not inside it.
- `value?: string`: What is submitted. Default `"on"`, as a native checkbox's.
- `(checkedChanged): { checked: boolean; details: ChangeDetails }`: The change with why it happened; `details.cancel()` keeps the value.

Each part, and its own props:

- `[kuiSwitch]` is `KuiSwitch`. `exportAs: "kuiSwitch"`. On the box's element. It draws the hidden native input inside it, which a form and a label reach. Its props are above.
- `[kuiSwitchThumb]` is `KuiSwitchThumb`.

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- root: The track. It holds a hidden native checkbox, which a form and a label reach.
    - `data-checked`: Present when it is checked.
    - `data-unchecked`: Present when it is not checked.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-readonly`: Present when it can be read but not changed.
    - `data-required`: Present when the form needs it.
- thumb: The knob that moves along the track.
    - `data-checked`: Present when it is checked.
    - `data-unchecked`: Present when it is not checked.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-readonly`: Present when it can be read but not changed.
    - `data-required`: Present when the form needs it.

### Tabs

```
import { KuiTabs, KuiTabsList, KuiTabsTab, KuiTabsIndicator, KuiTabsPanel } from "@kirana-ui/angular"
```

Parts: `[kuiTabs]`, `[kuiTabsList]`, `[kuiTabsTab]`, `[kuiTabsIndicator]`, `[kuiTabsPanel]`.

Anatomy:

```
kuiTabs
  kuiTabsList
    kuiTabsTab (repeated)
    kuiTabsIndicator
  *kuiTabsPanel (repeated)
```

Props of its root:

- `[(value)]: Value | null`: The active tab's value; `null` is "none".
- `defaultValue?: NoInfer<Value> | null`: Read once. Without one, the first tab that can be chosen is, once the page is there.
- `orientation?: Orientation`: Whether the tabs are laid out across (the default) or down: the arrows that move between them follow.
- `(valueChanged): { value: Value; details: ChangeDetails }`: The change with why it happened; `details.cancel()` keeps the value.

Each part, and its own props:

- `[kuiTabs]` is `KuiTabs`. `exportAs: "kuiTabs"`. Generic: `<Value = unknown>`. Its props are above.
- `[kuiTabsList]` is `KuiTabsList`.
    - `activateOnFocus?: boolean`: Whether moving focus onto a tab with the arrows activates it. Default `false`.
    - `loop?: boolean`: Whether the arrows wrap from the last tab to the first. Default `true`.
- `[kuiTabsTab]` is `KuiTabsTab`.
    - `value: unknown`: Required. What the tabs' value is while this tab is the active one.
    - `disabled?: boolean`: Disables this tab: it cannot be chosen.
- `[kuiTabsIndicator]` is `KuiTabsIndicator`.
- `[kuiTabsPanel]` is `KuiTabsPanel`. Structural: written `*kuiTabsPanel`. `<div *kuiTabsPanel="'account'">`: in the page while its tab is the active one; `*kuiTabsPanel="'account'; keepMounted: true"` keeps it, hidden.
    - `*kuiTabsPanel: unknown`: The directive's own value: `*kuiTabsPanel="…"`. Required. The value of the tab this is the panel of.
    - `keepMounted?: boolean`: Written after the directive's value: `*kuiTabsPanel="…; keepMounted: …"`. Keeps the panel in the page, `hidden`, while its tab is not the active one.

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- root: Groups the tabs and their panels.
    - `data-orientation="horizontal | vertical"`: The way the tabs are laid out.
    - `data-activation-direction="left | right | up | down | none"`: Where the newly active tab is from the one before, for a panel or a mark that slides.
- list: The row of tabs. The arrows move between them.
    - `data-orientation="horizontal | vertical"`: The way the tabs are laid out.
    - `data-activation-direction="left | right | up | down | none"`: Where the newly active tab is from the one before, for a panel or a mark that slides.
- tab: A button that shows its panel.
    - `data-active`: Present on the tab whose panel is shown.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-orientation="horizontal | vertical"`: The way the tabs are laid out.
- indicator: A mark for the active tab: it carries that tab's position and size.
    - `data-orientation="horizontal | vertical"`: The way the tabs are laid out.
    - `data-activation-direction="left | right | up | down | none"`: Where the newly active tab is from the one before, for a panel or a mark that slides.
    - `--active-tab-left`: The active tab's distance from the list's left edge.
    - `--active-tab-right`: The active tab's distance from the list's right edge.
    - `--active-tab-top`: The active tab's distance from the list's top edge.
    - `--active-tab-bottom`: The active tab's distance from the list's bottom edge.
    - `--active-tab-width`: The active tab's width.
    - `--active-tab-height`: The active tab's height.
- panel: A tab's content. In the page while its tab is active, and through its exit.
    - `data-hidden`: Present while its tab is not the active one.
    - `data-orientation="horizontal | vertical"`: The way the tabs are laid out.
    - `data-activation-direction="left | right | up | down | none"`: Where the newly active tab is from the one before, for a panel or a mark that slides.
    - `data-starting-style`: Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from.
    - `data-ending-style`: Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends.

### Toast

```
import { KuiToastViewport, KuiToastList, KuiToastRoot, KuiToastContent, KuiToastTitle, KuiToastDescription, KuiToastClose, KuiToastAction } from "@kirana-ui/angular"
```

Parts: `[kuiToastViewport]`, `[kuiToastList]`, `[kuiToastRoot]`, `[kuiToastContent]`, `[kuiToastTitle]`, `[kuiToastDescription]`, `[kuiToastClose]`, `[kuiToastAction]`.

Anatomy:

```
kuiToastViewport
  *kuiToastList
    kuiToastRoot (repeated)
      kuiToastContent (optional)
        kuiToastTitle
        kuiToastDescription
      kuiToastClose
      kuiToastAction
```

Props of its root:

- `toast: ToastRecord`: Required. The toast it draws: the one `*kuiToastList` gave its template (`let toast`).

Each part, and its own props:

- `[kuiToastViewport]` is `KuiToastViewport`. `exportAs: "kuiToastViewport"`. Where a toaster's toasts are drawn. Always in the page: put it once, near the root.
    - `toaster: Toaster`: Required. The page's toaster: one is made with `createToaster()`, once, in a module.
    - `label?: string`: What the region of toasts is called, for assistive technology.
    - `hotkey?: string`: The key that takes focus to the toasts. Default: `"F6"`.
    - `swipeDirection?: "left" | "right" | "up" | "down"`: The way a toast is dragged to close it. Default: `"right"`.
- `[kuiToastList]` is `KuiToastList`. Structural: written `*kuiToastList`. Its template is given the entry: `let entry` is a `ToastRecord`. `<div *kuiToastList="let toast">`: its template once for each toast, the newest first.
- `[kuiToastRoot]` is `KuiToastRoot`. One toast, on the element `*kuiToastList` draws for it. Its props are above.
- `[kuiToastContent]` is `KuiToastContent`. What holds a toast's contents, when the design sizes the toast itself.
- `[kuiToastTitle]` is `KuiToastTitle`. The toast's title, unless something is written in its element.
- `[kuiToastDescription]` is `KuiToastDescription`. The toast's description, unless something is written in its element.
- `[kuiToastClose]` is `KuiToastClose`. Closes the toast.
- `[kuiToastAction]` is `KuiToastAction`. The toast's action, its label unless something is written in its element. A press tells the action (`onAction`), then closes the toast unless the action called `details.cancel()`.

A page's toasts are a toaster's, made once in a module: `import { createToaster } from "@kirana-ui/angular"`, then `export const toaster = createToaster(options)` (`ToasterOptions`, under "Types"). The viewport is given it, and anything on the page adds to it: `toaster.add({ title, description, action, priority })`, `toaster.update(id, options)`, `toaster.dismiss(id)`, `toaster.promise(promise, { loading, success, error })`. What each takes and gives back is `Toaster`, `ToastOptions`, `ToastActionOptions` and `ToastRecord` under "Types".

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- viewport: Where the toasts are drawn: a region that is always in the page.
    - `data-expanded`: Present while the pointer or focus is on the stack: the toasts are spread out, and wait.
    - `--toast-frontmost-height`: The height of the newest toast.
- root: One toast.
    - `data-starting-style`: Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from.
    - `data-ending-style`: Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends.
    - `data-expanded`: Present while the pointer or focus is on the stack: the toasts are spread out, and wait.
    - `data-type`: The kind the toast was added as.
    - `data-limited`: Present on a toast behind as many as are shown at once.
    - `data-swiping`: Present while the toast is dragged.
    - `data-swipe-direction="left | right | up | down"`: The way the toast was dragged out, once it has been.
    - `--toast-index`: Its place in the stack: 0 for the newest.
    - `--toast-height`: Its height.
    - `--toast-offset-y`: The height of the toasts in front of it.
    - `--toast-swipe-movement-x`: How far it has been dragged across.
    - `--toast-swipe-movement-y`: How far it has been dragged up or down.
- content: What holds a toast's contents, when the design sizes the toast itself.
    - `data-behind`: Present on a toast that is behind the newest.
    - `data-expanded`: Present while the pointer or focus is on the stack: the toasts are spread out, and wait.

### Toggle

```
import { KuiToggle } from "@kirana-ui/angular"
```

Props:

- `[(pressed)]: boolean`: Whether it is pressed, when the caller holds it.
- `defaultPressed?: boolean`: Read once.
- `disabled?: boolean`: Disabled: a press does nothing.
- `value?: unknown`: In a toggle group: what the group's value holds while this one is pressed.
- `(pressedChanged): { pressed: boolean; details: ChangeDetails }`: The change with why it happened; `details.cancel()` keeps the value.

`[kuiToggle]` is `KuiToggle`. `exportAs: "kuiToggle"`. Inside a `kuiToggleGroup`, `value` makes it one of the group's toggles.

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- root: The button. It stays pressed until it is pressed again.
    - `data-pressed`: Present while it is pressed.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.

### ToggleGroup

```
import { KuiToggleGroup } from "@kirana-ui/angular"
```

Props:

- `[(value)]: readonly Value[]`: The values of the pressed toggles: none, one, or with `multiple` several.
- `defaultValue?: readonly Value[]`: The values pressed at the start, when the caller does not hold `value`. Read once.
- `multiple?: boolean`: Whether more than one can be pressed at a time.
- `disabled?: boolean`: Disables every toggle of the group.
- `orientation?: Orientation`: Whether the toggles are laid out across (the default) or down: the arrows that move between them follow.
- `loop?: boolean`: Whether the arrows go round from the last toggle to the first. Default: they do.
- `(valueChanged): { value: Value[]; details: ChangeDetails }`: Heard as a toggle is about to be pressed or released, with the values that would then be pressed: `details.cancel()` keeps them as they were.

`[kuiToggleGroup]` is `KuiToggleGroup`. `exportAs: "kuiToggleGroup"`. Generic: `<Value = unknown>`. Toggles that are one control. Each `kuiToggle` with a `value` inside it is one of its toggles.

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- root: The group. A toggle inside it with a `value` is one of its toggles.
    - `data-orientation="horizontal | vertical"`: Whether its toggles are in a row or a column.
    - `data-multiple`: Present when several can be pressed at a time.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.

### Toolbar

```
import { KuiToolbar, KuiToolbarButton, KuiToolbarLink, KuiToolbarInput, KuiToolbarGroup, KuiToolbarSeparator } from "@kirana-ui/angular"
```

Parts: `[kuiToolbar]`, `[kuiToolbarButton]`, `[kuiToolbarLink]`, `[kuiToolbarInput]`, `[kuiToolbarGroup]`, `[kuiToolbarSeparator]`.

Anatomy:

```
kuiToolbar
  kuiToolbarGroup (optional, repeated)
    kuiToolbarButton (repeated)
    kuiToolbarLink (repeated)
    kuiToolbarInput (repeated)
  kuiToolbarSeparator (repeated)
```

Props of its root:

- `orientation?: Orientation`: Whether the controls are laid out across (the default) or down: the arrows that move between them follow.
- `loop?: boolean`: Whether the arrows go round from the last item to the first. Default: they do.
- `disabled?: boolean`: Disables every control of the toolbar.

Each part, and its own props:

- `[kuiToolbar]` is `KuiToolbar`. `exportAs: "kuiToolbar"`. Its props are above.
- `[kuiToolbarButton]` is `KuiToolbarButton`.
    - `disabled?: boolean`: Disables this control.
- `[kuiToolbarLink]` is `KuiToolbarLink`.
- `[kuiToolbarInput]` is `KuiToolbarInput`. `<input kuiToolbarInput>`: the arrows are its own until the caret is at an end.
    - `disabled?: boolean`: Disables this control.
- `[kuiToolbarGroup]` is `KuiToolbarGroup`.
    - `disabled?: boolean`: Disables this control.
- `[kuiToolbarSeparator]` is `KuiToolbarSeparator`.

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- root: The toolbar. It is one stop for Tab.
    - `data-orientation="horizontal | vertical"`: Whether the toolbar is a row or a column.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- button: A button of the toolbar.
    - `data-orientation="horizontal | vertical"`: Whether the toolbar is a row or a column.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- link: A link of the toolbar.
    - `data-orientation="horizontal | vertical"`: Whether the toolbar is a row or a column.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- input: A text input of the toolbar. The arrows are its own until the caret is at an end.
    - `data-orientation="horizontal | vertical"`: Whether the toolbar is a row or a column.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- group: Items that belong together.
    - `data-orientation="horizontal | vertical"`: Whether the toolbar is a row or a column.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- separator: A line between items, across the toolbar.
    - `data-orientation="horizontal | vertical"`: Whether the toolbar is a row or a column.

### Tooltip

```
import { KuiTooltip, KuiTooltipTrigger, KuiTooltipPortal, KuiTooltipPositioner, KuiTooltipPopup, KuiTooltipArrow } from "@kirana-ui/angular"
```

Parts: `[kuiTooltip]`, `[kuiTooltipTrigger]`, `[kuiTooltipPortal]`, `[kuiTooltipPositioner]`, `[kuiTooltipPopup]`, `[kuiTooltipArrow]`.

Anatomy:

```
kuiTooltip
  kuiTooltipTrigger
  *kuiTooltipPortal
    kuiTooltipPositioner
      kuiTooltipPopup
        kuiTooltipArrow
```

Props of its root:

- `[(open)]: boolean`: Whether it is open, when the caller holds it.
- `defaultOpen?: boolean`: Whether it starts open, when the caller does not hold `open`. Read once.
- `delay?: number`: How long the pointer rests on the trigger before the popup opens, in milliseconds. Default `600`.
- `closeDelay?: number`: How long after the pointer leaves the popup closes, in milliseconds. Default `0`.
- `disabled?: boolean`: Disabled: the pointer and focus do not open it.
- `(openChanged): { open: boolean; details: ChangeDetails }`: The change with why it happened; `details.cancel()` keeps the value.

Each part, and its own props:

- `[kuiTooltip]` is `KuiTooltip`. `exportAs: "kuiTooltip"`. On any element, or on `<ng-container>` to draw none. Its props are above.
- `[kuiTooltipTrigger]` is `KuiTooltipTrigger`.
    - `delay?: number`: Its own waits, which come before the root's.
    - `closeDelay?: number`: How long after the pointer leaves this trigger's popup closes, in milliseconds.
- `[kuiTooltipPortal]` is `KuiTooltipPortal`. Structural: written `*kuiTooltipPortal`. Draws what it holds at the end of `<body>`, or in the container a `PortalProvider` names.
- `[kuiTooltipPositioner]` is `KuiTooltipPositioner`. Takes the positioner options ("Positioner options", above).
- `[kuiTooltipPopup]` is `KuiTooltipPopup`.
- `[kuiTooltipArrow]` is `KuiTooltipArrow`.

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- trigger: The element the tooltip describes.
    - `data-popup-open`: Present when the tooltip is open.
- positioner: Places the popup against the trigger. It carries the geometry.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-side="top | right | bottom | left | inline-start | inline-end"`: The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip. Asked for as `inline-start` or `inline-end`, it says one of those two when it is beside its anchor.
    - `data-align="start | center | end"`: How it is aligned with the anchor.
    - `--anchor-width`: The anchor's width.
    - `--anchor-height`: The anchor's height.
    - `--available-width`: The width between the anchor and the edge of the viewport.
    - `--available-height`: The height between the anchor and the edge of the viewport.
    - `--transform-origin`: The point of the popup nearest its anchor, to scale from.
- popup: The tooltip itself.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-starting-style`: Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from.
    - `data-ending-style`: Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends.
    - `data-side="top | right | bottom | left | inline-start | inline-end"`: The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip. Asked for as `inline-start` or `inline-end`, it says one of those two when it is beside its anchor.
    - `data-align="start | center | end"`: How it is aligned with the anchor.
    - `data-instant="delay | focus | dismiss"`: Present when it opened or closed without its usual wait, for a design that skips the motion then.
- arrow: An element that points at the trigger, placed along the popup's edge.
    - `data-side="top | right | bottom | left | inline-start | inline-end"`: The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip. Asked for as `inline-start` or `inline-end`, it says one of those two when it is beside its anchor.
    - `data-align="start | center | end"`: How it is aligned with the anchor.
    - `data-uncentered`: Present when the popup was pushed along its edge, so the arrow is not at the trigger's centre.
